cells.place: On the wall of Āḷagar †
cells.remarks: Gift of land.

cells.place: On the west wall of Āḷagar temple †
cells.remarks: Mutilated. A portion of the historical introduction of the king is preserved.

cells.place: On the wall of Āḷagar †
cells.remarks: Mutilated. A portion of the historical introduction of the king is preserved.

cells.location: Śēvūrpiṭṭi
cells.place: On the wall of Āḷagar †
cells.remarks: Gift of a lamp. The temple is called Nīlakaṇṭha Karuṇākara-īśvaramuḍaiyār-Tirun-Tirunirōṇḍalai in Kīḷa-kīḷa-kūṟṟam, a sub-division of Muṇḍigōḷa-Chōḷavaḷanāḍu, a district of Rājēndra-Pāṇḍi-nāḍu.

cells.location: Śēvūrpiṭṭi
cells.place: On the wall of Āḷagar †
cells.remarks: Mutilated. A portion of the historical introduction of the king is preserved.

cells.place: On the south wall of Āḷagar temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of a lamp by a merchant of Karuṇākarapuram in Kīḷakkudi-nāḍu to the temple of Nīlakaṇṭha Karuṇākara-īśvaramuḍaiyār at Ten-Tirunirōṇḍalai in Kīḷa-kīḷa-kūṟṟam.

cells.place: On the wall of Āḷagar †
cells.remarks: The stones do not fit in the original order.

cells.location: Śēvūrpiṭṭi
cells.place: On the wall of Āḷagar †
cells.remarks: Gift of a lamp by a native of the Chōḷa country.

cells.location: Śēvūrpiṭṭi
cells.place: On the wall of Āḷagar †
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Incomplete. Gift of a lamp.

cells.place: On the south and west walls of Āḷagar temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of sheep for a lamp to the temple of Ninraruliṇa Karumā-nikkadēvar at Ten-Tirumāliruñjōlai, a dēvadāna in Kīlkala-kūtram by the queen of a certain Satrubhayamkaru-Muttaraiyan. Gift of land by the mahāsabhdā of Śrivallabhamaṅgalau, a brahma-dēya in Kīlkala-kūtram, a sub-division of Rājarāja-mandalam.

cells.place: On one of the pillars in the Ambalavāṇasvāmin temple at Māndūr
cells.remarks: Registry an agreement of the mahāsabhā of Mānañallūr, a brāhmaṇadēya in Kalakkudi-nāḍu.

cells.place: On another pillar in the place of Ambalavāṇasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Gift of land in Mānañallūr. Mentions the temple of Kalasēkhara-Viṇṇagar-Aḻvār at Karuvāḻnallūr alias Vikrama-Pāṇḍya-nallūr in Kalakkudi-nāḍu.

cells.place: At the top of an image set up in front of Ambalavāṇasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Below the inscription is the figure of a man with outstretched hands of which the left arm holds a sword.

cells.place: At the top of another image in the place of Ambalavāṇasvāmin. †
cells.remarks: Below the figure of a man is a man holding a club in each of the hands. The inscription refers to the threatened destruction of a village and its rescue by one who fell in the attempt.

cells.place: On a pillar set up in the place of Ambalavāṇasvāmin †
cells.remarks: The stone is set up on a platform which covers the lower portion of the inscription. It mentions the trading communities of a village and a town.

cells.place: On another face of the pillar of Ambalavāṇasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Unfinished and damaged. Seems to be similar in contents to No. 427.

cells.place: On a stone lying in front of the Maḍindā-chiyār shrine near the tank in the same village (as Ambalavāṇasvāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of land.

cells.place: On a sīralgal set up near the bund of the same tank.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Appears to be a gift of land for some service in connection with the tank.

cells.location: Murappunāḍu
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Nārāyaṇa-Peruṇāl temple
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Gift of land to the temple of Sōmadēva-Viṇṇagar-Aḻvār at Sōmidēva-chaturvēdimangalam, a brāhmaṇadēya in Murappunāḍu.

cells.place: On the wall of Nārāyaṇa-Peruṇāl... †
cells.remarks: Mentions Murappunāḍu alias Sōmidēva-chaturvēdimangalam and Yādavarāya-bhaṭṭa.

cells.place: On the south wall of Nārāyaṇa-Peruṇāl temple... †
cells.remarks: Mentions the temple of Cāḍukavāka-Viṇṇagar-Aḻvār at Murappunāḍu alias Sōmidēva-chaturvēdimangalam.

cells.place: On the north, west and south walls of Nārāyaṇa-Peruṇāl temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the shrine of Sōmidēva-Viṇṇagar-Aḻvār built on the bank of the river Tamraparṇyāru at Sōmidēva-chaturvēdimangalam in Murappunāḍu.

cells.place: On the same walls
cells.remarks: Mentions Śrī-Pāṇḍya Vīra-Sōmidēva-chaturvēdimangalam, a brāhmaṇadēya in Murappunāḍu and a sale made in the 11th year (of the king's reign).

cells.location: Daṇyakar-kōṭṭai
cells.place: On the west wall of the central shrine in the ruined Śiva temple in the fort
cells.remarks: The temple is called Tā[n]dō[n]rīśuramudaiyār at [Tura]valātr alias Nflagiri-gādāraṇan-kōṭṭai in Oduvaṅgā-nādu, a district of Kongu-maṇgalam.

cells.place: On the west wall of the maṇḍapa in front of Hoysala Śiva temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of two villages to the temple of Pāṇḍyapurīśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyaṇār at Dhaṇyakar-kōṭṭai in Nāgari-śikhāmaṇi-vaḷanāḍu, by Māḍappan-Śiṅgaya-Daṇṇāyakar. One of them had been granted in Śaka-Samvat 1268 expired, Īśvara.

cells.place: On the wall of Śiva †
cells.remarks: Specifies the names of the dancing girls who had to serve in the temple of Tāṇḍōṇrīnāyanār at Turuvaiūr alias Nīlagiri-sīdhāraṇa-kōṭṭai in Oḍuvakkūḍu-nāḍu, a dam.

cells.location: Daṇyakar-kōṭṭai
cells.place: On the wall of Śiva †
cells.remarks: Registers an order of the god Chaṇḍīśvara. The place is called Turuvaiūr alias Nīlagiri-sīdhāraṇa-kōṭṭai in Oḍuvakkūḍu-nāḍu, a dam.

cells.place: On the north wall of Śiva temple †
cells.remarks: Records that the mahāpradhāna Immaḍi-Rāhuttarāya Siṅgaiya-Daṇṇāyaka granted to the temple the proceeds of certain taxes on weavers and a ferry boat.

cells.place: On the wall of Śiva †
cells.remarks: Gift of money for offerings.

cells.location: Daṇyakar-kōṭṭai
cells.place: On the wall of Śiva †
cells.remarks: Mentions the mahāpradhāna Immaḍi-Rāhuttarāya Siṅgaiya-Daṇṇāyaka. Records that the Vāśiyavāṇiya-nagarattār agreed to contribute a fixed amount for the benefit of the temple on certain articles of merchandise such as female cloths, pepper, arecanuts, thread, salt, grains and horses. The temple is called Tāṇḍōṇrīnāyanār at Turuvaiūr alias Sītakaraṇḍan-kōṭṭai in Oḍuvāḍu-nāḍu.

cells.place: On the east wall of the mandapa in front of the Vishnu tem. le in the same village (as Śiva temple). †
cells.remarks: Refers to the boar incarnation of Vishnu.

cells.place: On the south and east walls of Śiva temple. †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Gift of land by the residents of Eḷugara-nāḍu for the requirements of the temple of Mādhava-Perumāḷ.

cells.place: On one of the pillars of the mandapa in front of the Vīrabhadrasvāmin temple in the same village (as Śiva temple). †
cells.remarks: In modern characters. Mentions the Vīrabhadrasvāmin temple.

cells.place: On the dhvajastambha of Vīrabhadrasvāmin temple †
cells.remarks: Records the setting up of the dipada-vṛishabhastambha.

cells.place: On the south wall of the central shrine in the Arjuṇēśvara temple at Kōṭūr near Sīmūṭūr.
cells.remarks: Records that Kūpakarāya, the son of Malavarāya, rebuilt the temple and gave different names to the god and his consort in order to secure merit for his parents. The temple is called Muohuku[nda] T[i]ruvirudāśvaramudaiya-Nāyanār at Srī-Kuntīdēvi-chaturvēdimangalam, a brahmadēya to the east of the tank (kulakkī) at Vēlār in Madurōdaya-valanādu.

cells.place: On the north, west and south walls of Arjuṇēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Seems to register a sale of land.

cells.place: On the same walls
cells.remarks: Sale of land to Kūṭṭan Tiruviḍaiyāḍin alias Tribhuvanachakravar-tin-Nāyaṇār of Śrī-Kuṇṭidēvi-chaturvēdimangalam, a brahmadēya to the east of the tank at Vēḷūr in Madurōdaya vaḷanāḍu which was a dēvadāna of the temple of) Muḍivalaṅgu-Pāṇḍya-Īśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyaṇār (refers to the executive committee nīraḍha-sabhai) of the village and to the 24th year of the king's reign).

cells.place: On a stone set up near a channel in the same village (as Arjuṇēśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Records the construction of the channel.

cells.place: On another stone set up in the place of Arjuṇēśvara †
cells.remarks: Much damaged and mutilated.

cells.place: On a stone set up in a field near the same village (as Arjuṇēśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Much damaged and mutilated.

cells.place: At the entrance into the central shrine of the temple at Aṟpākkam, right side
cells.remarks: Records the cutting out of the cave and its consecration. Being published in the Epigraphia Indica by Mr. G. Venkoba Rao. Connected with No. 463. Being published in the Epigraphia Indica by Mr. G. Venkoba Rao.

cells.place: In the place of Arjuṇēśvara, left side †
cells.remarks: Mentions Irumuḍiśōḻa as the king's door-keeper and a certain Madhurāntaka-Māṇḍarāyar as his agent. Fragment. Mentions Kaṇḍan-Kāḷamēghāḻan of the Āpai-tamba-śūtra.

cells.place: On the west wall of the maṇḍapa in front of Arjuṇēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: In the Brāhmī character.

cells.place: On a stone built into the floor of the platform in front of the shrine of the goddess in Arjuṇēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Sale of land to the god Śaṅkapāṇi-īśvarar in the Kāḷamēgam (temple).

cells.place: At the entrance into the natural cave known as Pañchapāṇḍavar-paḍukkai in the same village (as Arjuṇēśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: The temple is called Nāyiṉār Añjāḍa-Perumāḷ alias Vēdāntathar on the bank of the (tank called) Brahmamīrtha in the middle of the Tuṅgāvanam forest. The forest belonged to the district of Vēḷaṅgāḍ-parru on the eastern side of the Tiruvāṇāmalai hill to the north of Tirumuḍi-kūṉ-Tēṉ-Muḍippu-uḷḷu.

cells.place: On the Āṉaimalai hill close to the Viḍaiyāra-kravartin Kuḷaśēkhararāyā who was pleased to take every country.
cells.remarks: In the Brāhmī character.

cells.place: On a stone set up in a field near Viḍuṅkāra-yuṇa-Poruṇai temple. †
cells.remarks: Partially damaged. The king was ruling the Rāṇāḍu seven thousand (country). Gift of land.

cells.place: On four boulders on the Kāḷugamalai hill near Māṅguḷam.
cells.king: [Chō]ḻa-Mārāyaru of the solar race, the Kāśyapa gōtra and the family of Karikāḷa.
cells.remarks: Fragment.

cells.place: On a slab built into the wall of another house near No. 469.
cells.remarks: Much worn. Seem to record that the image of Hanumān was set up by a Bōḍi. Gift of land.

cells.location: Tangutūru
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Mudamangala temple
cells.remarks: Built in at the back. Appears to record the remission of certain taxes on barbers by the mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Rāmarājayadēva-Mahārāja.

cells.place: On another slab set up in the place of Mudamangala. †
cells.remarks: Gift of a garuḍastambha pillar to the temple of Śrī-Madangōpāla-svāmin of Tangutūru.

cells.location: Ārakavēmvula
cells.place: On two faces of a pillar set up in the court-yard of the Vishnu temple
cells.remarks: Records a gift to a certain Vinnasaram. Pērbāna-vaṁśa and Bhaṭṭāditya are mentioned.

cells.place: On a slab lying in the same court-yard.
cells.remarks: Mentions Kámarusugári-Timmayya and Bráhmala-Mudiyam, the auoient name of Peddamudiyam in the Jammalamađugu táluka ; also Nandyála in Rénánđu.

cells.place: On a mutilated slab lying in front of the Bhairava temple in the same village (as Vishnu temple). †
cells.remarks: Gift of land by the mahđjanas of Chavudřru to Peda-Timmarsayya, son of Kámaru, perhaps identical with the person mentioned in No. 475.

cells.place: On a pillar set up in the court-yard of the Chennakēśavasvāmin temple at Kōrapāḍu
cells.remarks: The temple is called Chennakéśavaděva of Korapádu, which belonged to the Gandikóta-tíma.

cells.place: On two faces of a slab lying in the same court-yard.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Mentions Sájuva Komára-Tima[réa]-Ayyaváru.

cells.place: On two faces of a slab set up in the middle of the village of Gōpararam.
cells.remarks: The gift of land to the temple of Chennakēśavadēva at Gōpararam by Jaga-tāba (Jaganōbagaṇḍa?) Kamōchihāraja Ranga ya dēva-bhōda-mahārājulu. Mentions the mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Salakarāja-Tiru-malayadēva-Mahārājulu; see No. 174, above.

cells.place: On a mutilated stone set up in the place of Chennakēśavasvāmin. †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Mentions Kumāra-Dēvarājaryya of the Vādhūla-gōtra and Āpastamba-sūtra. The former receives the title Vēdamārga-pratishṭhāpanāchārya.

cells.place: On another mutilated slab set up in the place of Chennakēśavasvāmin. †
cells.remarks: Record of a gift of land by Appājigāru, son of the āchāryya mentioned in No. 480, above.

cells.location: Poḍḍaśēṭipalle
cells.place: On a slab lying in the court-yard of the Chennakēśavasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land to the temple of Chennakēśava-Perumāḷ at Saṭṭipalle by the mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Rāmarāja-Rāyaraṇiḍa-Koṇḍarāja-dēva-Mahārāja. Aiyya-kāmarāja-ayyavāru is also mentioned.

cells.location: Vullitrapalle
cells.place: On a slab lying in the Bhīmēśvara temple
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions that the king boasts of having levied tribute from the Kōmāṭi.

cells.place: On a pillar lying near the Māriyamma temple in the same village (as Bhīmēśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Mutilated. In archaie characters. Mentions the king's birudas, viz. (mā) hārājādhirāja, pa ramēśvara and bhaṭ[ṭāra].

cells.location: Gaṇḍikōṭa
cells.place: On the south wall of the prākāra of the ruined Ranganāyaka temple
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Kēśavadēva at Gaṇḍikōṭa by the mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Chima-Avubhaladēva-Mahārāja, son of mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Rāmarāja and grandson of Aravīḍu-Rāmarāja-Mahārāja of Nandyāla.

cells.place: On the wall of Ranganāyaka †
cells.remarks: Gift by Nandyéla Timmuyaděva-Maháráju, grandson of Nandy[é]la Avubalésvaraděva-Maháráju to the temple of Raghunáthadbad on the Ghandikóta-durga.

cells.place: On the north wall of the prākāra of Ranganāyaka †
cells.remarks: Gift to the Reghunáyaka temple at Gandikóta by a merchant (kómatí).

cells.place: On the east face of a slab set up in a field near the Raṅgināmahal in the same village (as Ranganāyaka temple). †
cells.remarks: Remission of taxes in favour of the fishermen living in the new street at Kammaḍūru by the mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Nārasimha-rājayadēva-Mahārāju of Nandyāla.

cells.place: On a boulder near the Nāgadhari, outside the fort, in the same village (as Ranganāyaka temple). †
cells.remarks: Gift of two gardens to the temple of Uhathnarāya at Nāgadhari by Krishnappa-Timmarāju-Nāgarāju-Veñkaṭrāju-Koṇdrāju of Aravīṭi for the merit of Rangapatirāju.

cells.place: On a boulder near the waterfall in the garden called Pārēbāgh on the bank of the Pennēru river, at the foot of the Ghandikōṭa hill.

cells.location: Pulivendla
cells.place: On a slab set up at the entrance into the Raṅganāthasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Records the gift of a village by Narasingadēva-Mahārāja of the Vāshṭhī-gōtra and the site of the village to the temple of Mādhavarman of Bēravāḍa. It belonged to Pulivendla, situated in the Mulikināḍu-sīma, a sub-division of the Ghaṇḍikōṭa-sīma, a district of the Udayagiri-rājya.

cells.place: On two faces of a slab lying at the entrance into the Āñjanēyasvāmin temple in the same village (as Ranganāthasvāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: Records a charter granted to the merchants, reddis, karṇams, etc., of Pulivendla-sīma, by Yellappa-Nāyaningāru of the Tuḷuva family, who was the agent of Timmarāju-Śākayadēva-Mahārāja.

cells.place: On three faces of a pillar set up at the entrance into the Śiva temple in the same village (as Ranganāthasvāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: Gift of land by the mādhavaṇḍavāra Jaṭāyi Kañchayadēva-Mahārāja.

cells.place: On a slab lying near Govinda Rao's house in the same village.
cells.remarks: Gift of a charter to the merchante (kōmatis) and oil-mongers of Pulvindhula who had deserted the town as they had been forced to supply provisions on credit to the authorities (diedṇam).

cells.place: On a slab lying near the well called Kaṭṭu-bhāvi on the way to the Mōpūr temple from Nalla cheruvupalle.
cells.remarks: Damaged. In arbaico characters. Mentions [E]la-Chōla-Ma[h]ārāju and Motturāju.

cells.location: Mōpūr
cells.place: On a slab lying behind the western gōpura of the Bhairavasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Records the building of the gōpura of the Mōpūr Bhairavadēva by Tirumalarāya, a servant of the king. Incomplete.

cells.place: On a stone lying near No. 496.
cells.remarks: In archaic characters. Gift of land by Śrī-Mallirāja.

cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the central shrine in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Remission of certain taxes in the villages belonging to temples and Brāhmaṇas of the Ghaṇḍikōṭa-sīma by the mādhavaṇḍavēra Timmarayadēva-Mahārāja, son of Narasingadēva-Mahārāja and Ghaṇḍikōṭa-Avabhādēva-Mahārāja of Nandyāla.

cells.place: On another slab set up in the same place
cells.remarks: Gift to the temple of 235 earohas payable every year in the villages belonging to the temple of Bhayiraēśvara at Mōpūru. The donor was Ayya[p]arsusgāru, son of Rāyasam Koṇdamarusayyagāru.

cells.place: On a slab lying near the rādhā-maṇḍapa in the same temple.
cells.king: Vīrapratāpa Sāva-Oḍaya, ‘lord of the Eastern Ocean’.
cells.remarks: Gift of a village by the king for the merit of his father Kaṇḍappa-Oḍaya and his mother Mangadēvi amma.

cells.place: On a slab built into the main drain in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Remission of taxes for the merit of Vīra Narasintharāya and Sālva Timmaya.

cells.place: On a slab built into the floor at the entrance into the central shrine of Bhairavasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Appears to be a gift by an officer of the mahā-maṇḍalēśvara Nandila Timmarājadēva-Mahārāju to the Bhairavasvāmin temple at Mōpūr.

cells.place: On the wall at the entrance into the maṇḍapa in front of Bhairavasvāmin temple, left side. †
cells.king: Vīrapratāpa Sāva-Oḍaya, ‘lord of the Eastern Ocean’
cells.remarks: Gift of land to Bhairavasvāmin of Mōmpūru by the king for the merit of his father Kaṇḍappa and his mother Maṅgadēvi-amma.

cells.place: In the place of Bhairavasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Much damaged.

cells.place: In the place of Bhairavasvāmin, right side †
cells.remarks: Registers transaction concerning temple priests.

cells.place: On the right and left door-posts of the entrance into Bhairavasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the door post (?) by the mahāmaṇḍaleśvara, Bhramadeva-Chōḷa-Mahārāja, grandson of Bhōgādēvī and Bhramadēva. The chief calls himself the worshipper of the divine and glorious lotus-feet of the (god) Bhōgēśvaradēva of Pāmidi, Rōḍḍa-nāḍu, and of Ādityabhaṭṭāraka of the same place, belonging to the Chālukya-Vārāṇasi, the lord of Ayōdhyā, lord of the town of Ayōdhyā, worshipper of the feet of Allāḷanātha, [Pū]rṇṇā-rāja-Pemmayadēva-Mahārāja. The hero had gone on an expedition to the Mārajavāḍi country and died at Dhārāśīrtha.

cells.place: On a tirugal set up in the court-yard of Bhairavasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Appears to record transfers of rights in temple service and its emoluments.

cells.place: On the base of the central shrine in Bhairavasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Appears to record transfers of rights in temple service and its emoluments.

cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Damaged; another inscription is found close to this but its date is doubtful. [set of shares by k. priest]

cells.location: Mōpūr
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Do. sale of shares by k. priest

cells.location: Mōpūr
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Built in at the end.

cells.location: Mōpūr
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Built in at the end.

cells.location: Mōpūr
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Built in at the end.

cells.location: Mōpūr
cells.place: On the same base
cells.remarks: Built in at the end.

cells.location: Mottukūru
cells.place: On a slab built into the platform in front of the Chennakesavasvāmi temple
cells.remarks: Remission of taxes on barbers in the Ghaṇḍikōṭa-sīma originally by Rāmarājayya. Subsequently these as well as a few others were remitted by a local chief at Mottukūru, which belonged to the temple. It mentions the king.

cells.place: On a pillar set up in the court-yard of Chennakesavasvāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: In a archaic character. Muttukūru in 1-8 and seems to record the death of a hero.

cells.place: On a pillar set up at the entrance into the Sāḷuva court-yard of Chennakesavasvāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: The king is said to have been ruling at Vijayanagara. Gift of taxes payable in the village of Muttukūru in favour of the temple of Chennakēśavadēva by a servant of Narasingayinn-gāru, who was a subordinate of the king. The village Muttukūru was the chief village of the Ghaṇḍikōṭa-Bhairava-kṣētra on the Mūlanahēbhi hill in the Mukumūru country.

cells.place: On the door-post of the entrance into the Chōḷa central shrine of Chennakesavasvāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to a certain Pūṇana (Bhīmana?) gōravan by Bhakki-rāju. The king was ruling the Rēnaṇḍu seven thousand (county).

cells.place: On a pillar lying in front of the Śiva temple in the same village (as Chennakesavasvāmi temple). †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. In archaic characters.

cells.location: Ulimella
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Chennakēśava svāmi temple
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Mentions the temple of [Cho]ḷanākēśava Perumāḷ at Ulimla.

cells.location: Kadiri
cells.place: On a slab lying near a tamarind tree west of the Lakshminarasimhasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Records the reconstruction of a street, to the west of the Narasiṁha temple at Kadiri, in the name of Saṅgayadēva-Mahārāja, son of Chōḍarāyagurudēva-Mahārāja.

cells.place: On four faces of a pillar lying at the kitchen entrance into Lakshminarasimhasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Refers to Haribhara-Mahārāya.

cells.place: On a slab set up near the south wall of the main temple front of the central shrine in Lakshminarasimhasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: While the king was ruling at Dharamapuram and Penugonda, the temple of Arvabhīśvara at Kadiri was built by a Nāyaka.

cells.place: On another slab set up in the place of Lakshminarasimhasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Registers a Sanskrit verse with two meanings (ślēsha) composed by the pradhāna Sōvappa on the occasion of the gift of an ornament to the temple at Kadiri by Gōpaṇṇa, an officer of Kumāra-Kampaṇa.

cells.place: On a slab built into the floor of the court-yard of Lakshminarasimhasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Telūgn

cells.place: On a slab built into the floor of the kitchen in Lakshminarasimhasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of land to the temple of Narasiṁhadēva of Kadiri by a relation of the king.

cells.place: On a slab set up below a peepul tree in the court-yard of Lakshminarasimhasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to mention the Mūlas and Mādēgas.

cells.place: On a slab set up near the big gōpura of Lakshminarasimhasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the Kōḍimajjakitta in the Kadiri temple.

cells.place: On the base of the gōpura of Lakshminarasimhasvāmin, right and left sides. †
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Gives a genealogy of the first Vijayanagara dynasty. Seems to record the building of the gōpura by Viṭṭhalanātha, son of Dēvāpimātya.

cells.place: On the base of a platform in the 1000-pillared maṇḍapa of Lakshminarasimhasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records a gift by a merchant from Tāḍipatri (Tāḍipatri). Gift of the pillar.

cells.place: On a lamp pillar lying in front of Lakshminarasimhasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of the pillar.

cells.place: On another pillar set up in the place of Lakshminarasimhasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Gift of the pillar.

cells.place: On a boulder near the Vishnu temple at the foot of the Narasiṁhakonda hill, east of Kadiri.
cells.remarks: Gift of a garden.

cells.location: Pedda-Tippasamudram
cells.place: On a slab set up near the ruined Siva temple in the Yarraguntapalli field
cells.remarks: Prabhuchēruvin distinguished himself in the battle of Sōremaṭi between the king and Noḷambi, and fell.

cells.place: On a slab lying in the place of Siva †
cells.king: Parākēsarivarman alias Uḍaiyār Vīja Rajendra Chōḷadēva.
cells.remarks: Mentions [Ma]jambōr and a certain Nākinvarman.

cells.place: On a slab lying in the same place
cells.remarks: Fragment. In archaic characters. Seems to record the death of a hero; mentions Madurāntaka.

cells.place: On a slab lying in a field in the hamlet of Pallamvaripalle near the same village (as Siva temple). †
cells.remarks: Mentions the oldest son of Vīramahārāja.

cells.place: On a slab set up in the field called Balinadi in the same village (as Siva temple). †
cells.remarks: Mentions Kōyakuḷarāṇḍu alias Mūlai-Marapaḍi in Iratṭapāḍikoṇḍa-Chōḷamaṇḍalam.

cells.place: On a slab set up in the field called Balinadi in the same village (as Siva temple). †
cells.remarks: Mentions Nāgapa-Voḍaya.

cells.location: Morusupalle
cells.place: On a slab set up in a field near the Śiva temple
cells.remarks: Fragment in archaic characters. The imprecatory sentence is all that remains of the inscription.

cells.location: Puṅganūr
cells.place: On a broken slab lying on the tank-bund, west of the fort
cells.remarks: Damaged at the bottom. Mentions the tank called Rājēndraśōḷap-periyēri at Kuṅganūr alias Vaḷavanārāyaṇa-chaturvēdimaṅgalam in Puli-nāḍu, a district of Raṭṭapāḍikoṇḍa-Chōḷa-maṇḍalam.

cells.place: On a slab set up in the court-yard of the Sōmēśvarasvāmin temple in the same village (as Siva temple). †
cells.remarks: The inscription opens with the birudas of the king. Mentions the Tirukkoḷḷīśvaramuḍaiya-Mahādēvar at Kuṅganūr alias Vaḷavanārāyaṇa-chaturvēdimaṅgalam in Puli-nāḍu of Perumbāṇappāḍi, a sub-division of Paḍuvūr-kōṭṭam in Jayaṅgoṇḍa-Chōḷa-maṇḍalam.

cells.place: On a slab set up outside Sōmēśvarasvāmin temple †
cells.remarks: The king was ruling the Vaḍugavaḻi 12,000 and Maṇṇe 200. Refers to the raid on Kōyatūr by Kāḍuvaṭṭi-Muttarasan.

cells.place: On a slab set up in a field in front of the village of Chadalla, close to the Puṅganūr-Chadum road.
cells.remarks: Refers to the battle of Soremati where the Bāṇa opposed the Noḷamba, Rāchamalla and Mayindaḍi on behalf of the Permanaḍi (i.e. perhaps the Gaṅga king). Mentions Mādhavarasa of Kaṅganūra.

cells.place: On the gōpura of the Nīlakaṇṭhēśvara temple at Laddigam, right of entrance.
cells.remarks: In praise of the sword of Adigan i.e. Adiyamān Viḍugādaḻagiya Perumāḷ, whose name and emblems are engraved below the inscription.

cells.place: In the place of Nīlakaṇṭhēśvara; left of entrance †
cells.remarks: In praise of Adigēśan, i.e. Tagoḍūr Adiyamān Viḍugādaḻagiya-Perumāḷ, whose name and emblems are engraved below the inscription.

cells.place: On the south wall of the prākāra of Nīlakaṇṭhēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Mentions the temple of Iruṅgōḷīśvaramuḍaiya-Mahādēvar at Kōyāṟṟūr alias Uttama-Chōḷapuram.

cells.place: On the north wall of the prākāra of Nīlakaṇṭhēśvara †
cells.remarks: In praise of the Kēraḷa king Adhikēndra Vyāmuktaśravaṇōjjvala. The Tamil verses refer to his engraving the bow on the wall of the Iruṅgōḷīśvara temple. The inscription has the Chēra bow and other emblems on each side of it.

cells.place: On the south wall of the shrine in Nīlakaṇṭhēśvara temple, right of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Gift of money for three lamps to the temple of Iruṅgōḷīśvaramuḍaiya-Mahādēvar at Kōyāṟṟūr alias Uttama-Chōḷapuram.

cells.place: In the place of Nīlakaṇṭhēśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift to the temple of Iruṅ[g]ōḷīśvaramuḍaiya-[Nāya*]ṉār at Kōyāṟṟūr.

cells.location: Puṅganūr
cells.place: In the place of Nīlakaṇṭhēśvara †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Gift of 96 sheep for a lamp to the same temple.

cells.place: On the wall of Nīlakaṇṭhēśvara, left of entrance †
cells.remarks: Gift of money for the merit of Uttamachōḷa-Gaṅga Vēṭṭum Amarābharaṇan by Akaḷaṅka-Siyagaṅga alias Śītavidadēva. The temple is called Iruṅgōḷīśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyaṉār at Kōyāṟṟūr alias Uttama-Chōḷapuram in Vaḍa-Puli-nāḍu, a sub-division of Perumbāṇappāḍi in Jayaṅgoṇḍa-Chōḷa-maṇḍalam.

cells.place: On the east wall of Nīlakaṇṭhēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: In praise of Viḍugādaḻagiyan of Ten-Tagaḍai, whose enemies were the Kāḍava, the Māgada and the Gaṅga.

cells.place: On the south east, north and west walls of Nīlakaṇṭhēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of the village of Mādamaṅgalam in Puli-nāḍu, a district of Raṭṭapāḍikoṇḍa-Chōḷa-maṇḍalam (calling it Gaṅgaikoṇḍa-Chōḷanallūr) to the temple of Iruṅgōḷīśvaramuḍaiya-Mahādēvar built at Kōyāṟṟūr alias Uttamaśōḷapuram in the same nāḍu by Āḍavalāṉ Gaṅgaikoṇḍachōḷa alias Iruṅgōḷan.

cells.place: On a slab set up in the village of Padupala
cells.remarks: In archaic characters. Consists of the description of a king. Appears to be a fragment of a Bāṇa inscription.

cells.place: On a pillar set up in front of the Chauḍēśvarī temple in the same village (as Nīlakaṇṭhēśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Appears to record a cause of matter.

cells.place: On four tiers of the south, east and north walls of the Agastyēśvara temple on the Agastya-kūṭa hill.
cells.remarks: Gift of a village to the temple of Tiruvagattīśvaramuḍaiya-Mahādēva at Kōyarrūr alias Uttamaśōlapuram in Paḷḷi-nāḍu, a sub-division of Parakēśarimallanallūr in Jayaṅgoṇḍa-Chōḷa-maṇḍalam.

cells.place: On the west wall of Agastyēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of lamps, cows, vessels and land to the temple of Agastīśnathadēva.

cells.place: On the west wall of Agastyēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Records that the queen of Uttamaśōḷa-gaṅga alias Śolagaṅga set up and consecrated an image of Tirunavukkaraiśu-dēva.

cells.place: On the base of the west and south walls of Agastyēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Mentions Tirumani-Chikkarēvu Timmaya-Gaṅgāḍvuru.

cells.place: On the south wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine of Agastyēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: The second figure of the date is doubtful. Gift of an ornament.

cells.place: On the base of the wall of Agastyēśvara, right of entrance, first tier. †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Gift of a lamp by Śūranāḍyan alias Śiyagaṅgar.

cells.place: On the same base, second, third and fourth tiers.
cells.remarks: Gift of land by Vaḍagapillai alias Koṇḍanān.

cells.place: On the base of the Dakshiṇāmūrti-maṇḍapa in Agastyēśvara temple, first and second tiers. †
cells.remarks: Gift of two cows for a lamp by Śūranāḍyan alias Śiyagaṅgar.

cells.place: On the same base...
cells.remarks: Gift of land by Vaḍagapillai alias Koṇḍanān.

cells.place: On the boulder called Durga-guṇḍu on the hill of Agastyēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Built in the middle. Mentions Adigēśa [n].

cells.place: On a boulder in the field of Nokkanūru near Mittapalli.
cells.remarks: Damaged. At the bottom of this is another damaged inscription which mentions no king.

cells.place: On a boulder in the field of Nokkanūru near Mittapalli.
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Neykkunḍi to the temple of Tiruvagattīśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyanār.

cells.place: On the rock called Minikimāñi near Muṇiki.
cells.remarks: The Sanskrit portion mentions the Gaṅga family and Koṅkuṇivarman. The introduction belongs to Kulōttuṅga I, whose name is not mentioned. But the name Rājakēsarivarman and the title Chakravarttin occur at the end the introduction. The date here noted is in accordance with the date of the construction of a channel to the tank at Uppanēlli in Maḍukūru-nāḍu in Vaḍa-Pulinuḍu, a sub-division of Porumbāṇapāḍi in Nigarili-Chōḷa-maṇḍalam. The channel was improved by the son of the chief who built it.

cells.place: On a slab set up in the fields behind the ranoḍ village of Bhīḍipāḷe.
cells.remarks: Mentions Miniki and records the death of a hero.

cells.place: On another slab set up in the place of Agastyēśvara †
cells.remarks: Mentions Miniki and refers to the raid of the army of Nolamba on Puli-nāḍu.

cells.place: On a third slab set up in the place of Agastyēśvara †
cells.remarks: Mentions Miniki.

cells.location: Mūgēvīḍi
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Puṇyēśvara temple
cells.remarks: Registers an order of Jammaṇa Oḍeya and mentions Dāvarāya-Oḍeya.

cells.place: On another slab set up in the place of Puṇyēśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of land. The village whose name (Mūkkaiyāḍi) is damaged was situated in Puḷināḍu, a sub-division of Perumbānāppāḍi in Paḍavūr-kōṭṭam, a district of Jayaṅgoṇḍa-Chōḷamaṇḍalam.

cells.place: On a stone forming the roof of a small shrine in the court-yard of the same temple.

cells.location: Yāḷavākkil

cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Irungīśvaramuḍaiya-Mahādēvar built by a Veḷḷāḷa at Eṭṭavākkil in Puḷināḍu, a sub-division of Perumbānāppāḍi [in] Jayaṅgoṇḍa-Chōḷamaṇḍalam.

cells.place: On the walls of the same temple

cells.place: On the slab set up in the court-yard of the Chennakēśavasvāmin temple in the same village.
cells.remarks: Gift of the village of Eṭṭavākkil in Puḷi-nāḍu.

cells.place: On a śīragal set up in the village of Embāḍi.

cells.remarks: Records the death of a hero on the same occasion.

cells.place: On the third śīragal set up in the same place.

cells.remarks: Gift of a gold tile to the temple of Tiruvaiyaru-Mahadevar at Vembattur alias Sivanathachaturvedimangalam, a brahmadaya, a sub-division of Vadagarai-Rajendra-simha-valanadu.

cells.place: On a boulder north of the same temple
cells.remarks: Records a provision for offerings and lamps by a certain Paṇḍayan Brahmamārāyan.

cells.place: On a rock in a field to the west of the same village.
cells.remarks: In modern characters. Records a private gift. Mentions Tiruṇāḷ Siṇṇappa-Nāyakkar.

cells.location: Kāḷaiyūr
cells.place: On the south wall of the Kailāsanātha temple

cells.remarks: Gift of land for a lamp to the temple of Tiruvagattīśvaramuḍaiyār at Pāḷiūr in Paḷm[u]ni-kūṟṟam, a sub-division of [Śu]ttamalli-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Rishiyūr — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the Kailāsanātha temple
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Tiruvagattīśvaramuḍaiyār in Vēmbi-kūṟṟam, a sub-division of Śuttamalli-vaḷanāḍu. The donor had married a daughter of Vikrama-Chōḷa-Vāṇakōvaraiyar of Kaḷattūr.

cells.place: On the south wall of the central shrine in the Ōṅkārēśvara temple in the same village (as Chōḷēśvara temple). †

cells.place: On the wall of Ōṅkārēśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Öngariṣvaramudiyār built by Piljēi Jayadara-Pallavanaiyar.

cells.location: Kuṭṭālam
cells.place: On the wall of Ōṅkārēśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land. Mentions Pallavanarāyanapuram aliṣs Ulagamadēvipuram in Tiru vaĵṇ[d]armādu, a sub-division of Jayaṅgonda-(Chōla-valanādu.

cells.place: On the west wall of Ōṅkārēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Mutilated in the middle. Seems to record a gift of land.

cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of [Ö]ṅgariṣvaramudiyār built by Arayan Āludaiyanā[ya]gkanār aliṣs Jayadhara-Pallavaraiyar. Mentions Kavirinallor, a dievadna of the temple of Udaiyār Śonnavārayivār at Viṅgunirtturu [t]tji.

cells.remarks: Mentions the shrine of Vikramachōḷīśvaramuḍaiyār at Kara-vaḷanāḍu. Refers to the revenue survey in the 16th year of Sungandavitta-Kuḷōttunga-Chōḷadēva. The royal order is addressed to Vāgaḷavārayan.

cells.location: Nandalūr, Pullampet taluk, Cuddapah district — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the north and west wall of the Chandēś-vara shrine in Ōṅkārēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land. Mentions Aṇaiyappuram in Iruṅ[g]uṇ-ḍu-nāḍu, a sub-division of Jayangoṇḍa-Chōḷa-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Kuṭṭālam — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Uttaravēdīśvara temple
cells.remarks: Sale of land to the temple of Vīṅguṇṭūruttiaṭṭu-uḍaiya-Mahādēvar.

cells.place: On the wall of Uttaravēdīśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of money by a native of Gaṅgaikoṇḍachōḷapuram to the temple of Sungnavaiyār at Vīṅguṇṭūr-rutturti in Tiruvalundūr-nāḍu, a sub-division of Jayangoṇḍa-Chōḷa-vaḷanāḍu. The endowment was intended for feeding itinerant Saiva devotees in order to secure the prosperity of the village of Vīṅguṇṭūr.

cells.place: On the east wall of Uttaravēdīśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Sale of land by the sabhā of Vīṅguṇṭūr-mahādēvi-chatur-vēdimangalam, a Brahmadēya in Tiruvalundūr-nāḍu, a sub-division of U[y]yakkonḍār-vaḷanāḍu to the temple of Ti[ruk]kaṛrali-Mahādēva at Vīṅguṇṭūr-rutturuti.

cells.place: On the south wall of Uttaravēdīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: The temple is called Kalyāṇi-iḷai.

cells.place: On the north wall of the maṇḍapa in front of Uttaravēdīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land by the sabhā of Uttamachōḷa-chaturvēdi-maṅgalam, a brahmadēya in Virudarājabhayaṅkara-vaḷanāḍu, a sub-division of Rājarāja-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the wall of Uttaravēdīśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land by the sabhā of Pulōgau anikka-chaturvēdimaṅgalam, a brahmādēya in Virudarājabhavanikara-valanādu to the temple of Soṇpavārarivar at Vinganī[r]tiruturnitti.

cells.location: Kuṭṭālam
cells.place: On the wall of Uttaravēdīśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land by the sabhā of Piḷḷaiyān-chaturvēdi-maṅgalam, a sub-division of Virudarājabhayaṅkara-vaḷanāḍu, to the temple of Uḷaiyūr Sommanāthēśvarar at Viṅgamir-rutturuṭṭi in Tiruvēḷundūr-nāḍu, a sub-division of Tenkarai Rājarāja-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Kuṭṭālam
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Gift of land by the same sabhā to the same temple.

cells.location: Kūṭṭāḷam — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the north wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Uttavēdīśvara temple
cells.remarks: Gift of the proceeds of the taxe-jūdi and śillavari amounting to 90 pon in favour of the temple of Soṇpavārarivar. The gift was made by the king on the occasion of the māmāṅgum festival at the request of Basavarasa of Tiruppeya[r]īrū in Tondai-mandalam.

cells.place: On the wall of Uttavēdīśvara.. †
cells.remarks: Sale of a house site to a maṭha. Mentions the temple of Tiruchahattimurpamudaiyar at Kil-Palaiyara alas Rā[j]e[n][j]u[p]aram in Kolottuṅga Chōla-valanādu.

cells.place: On the first gōpura of the Svarṇṇamūyēśvaram temple at Svāmimalai, right of entrance.
cells.remarks: Damaged. The rāśi and a peacock are engraved on the top of the inscription.

cells.place: In the place of Svarṇṇamūyēśvaram †
cells.remarks: Built in the middle. Refers to the son of Timmappa-Nāyaka of the chaturvēdi-gōtra, who was a native of Neḍuṅgūram in Toṇḍaimāṇḍalam.

cells.location: Vijayanagara
cells.place: On a slab set up in the Kṛishṇasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Fresh copy of No. 25 of 1889.

cells.place: On a broken slab built into the floor of the Chaṇḍikēśvara temple in the same village (as Kṛishṇasvāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: Fresh copy of No. 85 of 1889.

cells.location: Vijayanagara
cells.place: On a broken slab in the underground temple
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Prasanna-Virūpāksha on the occasion of our coronation.

cells.place: On a rock near the Jaina temples in the same village (as Chaṇḍikēśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Mentions Bukknayave, the queen (ardhāṅgalukshami) of Vira-Harihararaya (Harihara II 9).

cells.location: Madura — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a detached stone lying in the Maḍaṅgō-pāḷasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Fragment. Mentions Tiruturuṭi-Mahādēvar and Perumāl in Aḍaḷanāḍu; seems to record the gift of a lamp.

cells.place: On another stone in the place of Maḍaṅgō-pāḷasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Seems to record the gift of a lamp.

cells.place: On a third stone in the place of Maḍaṅgō-pāḷasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Gift of a lamp by Koñjarañjāri of Korravayir-dēva in the temple at Tiruttani.

cells.location: Madura — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a fourth stone lying in the Madanagōpālasvāmī temple
cells.remarks: Fragment; seems to record a gift of cows.

cells.place: On eight other stones in the place of Madanagōpālasvāmi †
cells.remarks: One of the fragments mentions Pāṇḍyadēva-Pāṇḍyadēva and another the Śaivāchārya Śivagōchari-Mahā-dēva of the Bhāradvāja gōtra.

cells.place: On the fourteenth stone in the place of Madanagōpālasvāmi †
cells.remarks: Records a gift by the queen Ulagamuḷududaiyāḷ.

cells.place: On the fourteenth stone in the place of Madanagōpālasvāmi †
cells.remarks: The stone bears at the top the Pāṇḍya crest, i.e., two fish with a triśūla between them. Records the gift of a flower-garden by the queen Elulagamuḷudu-muḍiyāḷ.

cells.place: On the fifteenth and sixteenth stones in the place of Madanagōpālasvāmi †
cells.remarks: Fragments.

cells.place: On thirteen other stones in the place of Madanagōpālasvāmi †
cells.remarks: Purports to be the genealogy of the mahamaṇḍalēśvara Rāmarāja-Tirumalairāya-Mahārāja.

cells.place: On the west wall of Madanagōpālasvāmi temple †
cells.remarks: Unfinished.

cells.place: Inscriptions on the Dharmarāja-rathā
cells.remarks: South Ind. Inscr. Vol. I. Nos. 1 to 17. Fresh copies for re-publication in the Epigraphia Indica.

cells.place: On the same tier ..
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records a gift of land.

cells.place: On the 2nd, 3rd and 4th tiers on the same base.
cells.remarks: The temple is called Śrī-Kulōttuṅgachōḷa-Viṇṇagar-Āḻvār in śrī-Kulōttuṅga-Chōḷa-chaturvēdimaṅgalam, the agara-brahmadēya of Nirandanūr in Meṟpākkai-nāḍu, a sub-division of Adhirājēndra-maṇḍalam. Madhurāntaka-Poṭṭappichchōḷa-Siddharasa got the boundaries of the temple land engraved on stone.

cells.place: On the 4th tier of the same base ..
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning.

cells.place: On the 6th tier of the same base ..
cells.remarks: Damaged; seems to record a gift of land.

cells.place: On the lowermost portion of the south wall of Saumyanathasvamin temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land in Pottappi to the temple of Śokka-Perumāḷ in Nirandanūr.

cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.remarks: The temple is called Śokkapperumāḷ alias Śrī-Kulōttuṅgachōḷa-Viṇṇagar in Kulōttuṅga-Chōḷa-chaturvēdimaṅgalam, the agara-brahmadēya of Nirandanūr in Meṟpākkai-nāḍu, a sub-division of Adhirājēndra-maṇḍalam.

cells.place: On the 2nd, 3rd and 4th tiers of the west base of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Records a gift by Bhujabala Vīra[nā]rāyaṇa Āhavamalladēva Mahārāja and mentions Bhāskara-bhaṭṭōpādhyāya.

cells.location: Nandalūr, Pullampet taluk, Cuddapah district — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the north base of the same maṇḍapa, 1st tier.
cells.remarks: Records that Nallaṉ-Siddharasa, son of Madhurāntaka Poṭṭappichchōḷaṉ alias Erama-Siddharaśaṉ, exempted from certain taxes three villages, viz., Nirandanūr alias the agara-brahmadēya śrī-Kulōttuṅga-Chōḷa-chaturvēdimaṅgalam, Aṇḍappūr alias Tyāgasamudra-chaturvēdimaṅgalam and Mantram alias Bhujabala-siddhi-chaturvēdimaṅgalam.

cells.location: Nandalūr
cells.place: On the 2nd and 3rd tiers of the north base and on 3 tiers of the west base of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Saumyanāthasvāmin temple
cells.king: Parakēsarivarman alias Tribhuvanachakravartin śrī Vikrama Chōḷadēva.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of a village (in 70 shares), by the mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Vimalādityadēva, ruler of Poṭṭapi, for the success of the king's arms. The donor was the son of Siddharasa and was called Madhurāntaka-Poṭṭappi-Chōḷa.

cells.place: On the 6th tier of the north base, the north and west walls of the same mandapa and the north wall of the central shrine in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Contains a genealogy of the Telugu-Chōḍa chief Manmasiddha. Then there is a Telugu passage in Grantha characters and the end is in Tamil.

cells.place: On the 4th tier of the same base
cells.remarks: Gift of land for two lamps to the god Sokkapperumal of the temple of Kaḷōttuṅgachōḷa-Viṇṇagar-Emperumāṉ by Pūmi-Reḍḍi, son of Pūmi-Reḍḍi, sub-ordinate of the chieftain in Mōrgaḷnāḍu, a division of Adhirājarājēndra-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the 1st tier of the east base of Saumyanathasvamin temple, right of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Gift of lamps by Madurāntaka-Poṭṭappi-Chōḷa Tiruk-kaḷatti-dēva for the merit of his father Manumāntarājar, lord of Nallāḍūru.

cells.place: On the 2nd tier of the same base
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning. Records a gift by the mahāmaṇdalēivara Bettarasa, who was ruling Pottappi-nadū, for the success of the king's arms.

cells.place: On the 3rd and 4th tiers of the same base
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning. Records a gift by Madhurāntaka-Poṭṭappi-Chōḷa Vimalādityadēva, son of Siddhārasa.

cells.place: On the 2nd and 3rd tiers of the same base; left of entrance.
cells.remarks: Built in at the end. The mahāmaṇdalēivara Madurantaka-Pottappi-Chola-Siddharasa was ruling Pottappi-nadū.

cells.place: On the 4th tier of the same base
cells.remarks: Built in at the end. Gift of two lamps [by a native of] Maṅgaḍu in Kaḷōttuṅgachōḷa-vaḷanāḍu, a subdivision of Jayangoṇḍa-Chōḷamaṇḍalam.

cells.place: On the 5th and 6th tiers of the same base
cells.remarks: Built in at the end.

cells.place: On the south wall of the central shrine in the same temple.
cells.date: 17th year, Nandana. †
cells.remarks: Records that a native of Vaḷūru-nāḍu, a district of Muṇaikkōṭṭam in Jayangoṇḍa-Chōḷamaṇḍalam, laid the god goddess bathod.

cells.place: On the north and west bases of the central shrine in the Saumyanāthasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Records gifts by a woman belonging to the temple of Tiruvēṅgaḷanāthadēva. The temple is called Sau-myanāthasvāmin at Nalaṇḍūru, which was another name of Nīraṇṭapuram.

cells.location: Sattenapalle, Sattenapalle taluk, Guntur district — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the south wall of the tiruchuṟṟāḷigai of Saumyanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged.

cells.place: On the wall of Saumyanāthasvāmin.. †

cells.location: Nalaṇḍūru
cells.place: On the wall of Saumyanāthasvāmin.. †

cells.location: Nalaṇḍūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the same wall..

cells.place: On the inner eastern gōpura of the same temple, right side.

cells.location: Sattenapalle, Sattenapalle taluk, Guntur district — Andhra Pradesh

cells.remarks: Records a gift by a native of Muraṇōttamaṅgalam in Valluva-nāḍu, a district of Malai-maṇḍalam.

cells.location: Nalaṇḍūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: In the place of Saumyanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Gift by Perumāṇḍidēvaras, younger brother of Prasād[i]-Tikkaraśa and son of Jagadōbhaṇḍan Kamarasar.

cells.place: On the wall of Bhūvarahavara †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of land for a lamp to the temple of Tirupputtūr-Mahādēva in Paraḍā[ya]kuḍi, a brahmadēya in Tirunaraiyūr-nāḍu, a subdivision of Kshatriyaśikhāmaṇi-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Tirupparaṅkuṇram, Madura taluk, Madura district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east and south walls of Bhūvarahavara temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for offerings to the shrine of Sūryadēva constructed in the temple by a native of Kallūr in Mēl-Vemba-nāḍu, a subdivision of Pāṇḍi-nāḍu alias Rājarāja-maṇḍalam. Mentions Kurugūr maḍam.

cells.location: Āṇḍāṉkōyil
cells.place: On the east, south and west walls of the shrine of the goddess in the Śiva temple
cells.remarks: Mentions Āṇḍāyaṉārkōyil and records the gift of a maṭha by [a native of] Tirupputtūr in [Sē]rūr-[kūṟṟam], a subdivision of Arumo[ḻi]dēva-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Tirukkaḷittaṭṭai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Vēdapurīśvara temple
cells.remarks: Gift of land for rice offerings to the temple of Śrīkuḍittiṭṭai-Uḍaiyār in Vaḍagarai-Vembaṟṟūr, by the king's general (sēnāpati) Pirāntakaṉ Siriyavēḷār alias Tirukkaṟṟaḷi-Pichchaṉ.

cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.remarks: Refers to the remission of taxes on land belonging to the temple of Śrīkuḍittiṭṭai-Paramasvāmin in Vembaṟṟūr alias Śōḷamārttāṇḍa-chaturvēdimaṅgalam, a brahmadēya in Maṇṇi-nāḍu, which was a subdivision of Rājēndrasiṅga-vaḷanāḍu, by the assembly of that village. The taxes included among others 'the paddy for pañchavāriyam.'

cells.location: Tirukkaḷittaṭṭai
cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.remarks: Refers to a similar transaction by the same assembly. Mentions Rājarāja-Īśvaramuḍaiyār. The chief territorial division is here called Vaḍagarai Rājēndrasiṅga-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Tiru-kkuvaḷaṭṭai
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Veḷapparîśvara temple
cells.remarks: Registers still another transaction of the same kind.

cells.place: On the west wall of Vēdapārīsvara temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for offerings to the temple of Sri-Ādittai[ṭṭai-Perumāl] by a member of the assembly of Āmaṉārāyaṇat-chaturvēdimangalam in Aravaṇa-āḍai a brahmadāya in Vaḍagarai (i.e., the northern bank).

cells.place: On the wall of Vēdapārīsvara. †
cells.remarks: Gift [of land] for a lamp to the temple of Tiru-kkuvaḷaṭṭai-Perumāl in Āmaṉārāyaṇa-chaturvēdimangalam.

cells.location: Tiru-kkuvaḷaṭṭai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Vēdapārīsvara. †
cells.remarks: Gift of a silver pot to the temple of Sri-kuḍittai-Mahādēva at Vaṁbarragar by Sēmbiyan-Mahādēvīp-pirāttiyār, who gave birth to Uttama-Chōlaḍēva.

cells.location: Tiru-kkuvaḷaṭṭai
cells.place: On the wall of Vēdapārīsvara. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for offerings and for the supply of 108 betel-leaves and water to the temple of Mahādēva in Āmaṉārāyaṇa-chaturvēdimangalam by Kiḷaṉadigal, the daughter of Viḷupparaiyar and the queen of Uttama-Chōladēva, son of Gaṇḍarāditya. Unfinished. Gift of money for two lamps by the wife and daughter of Siriyavēḷar.

cells.place: On the south wall of Vēdapārīsvara temple †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Gift of money for two lamps by the wife and daughter of Siriyaveļar.

cells.place: On the wall of Vēdapārīsvara. †
cells.remarks: Do. Gift of money for two lamps.

cells.location: Tiru-kkuvaḷaṭṭai
cells.place: On the wall of Vēdapārīsvara. †
cells.remarks: Gift of 90 sheep for a lamp by Vemban Sijroļdaiyar alias Mina van-mahadēviyar, queen of Rajarajadēva. States that Amaninārayana-chaturvēdimangalam was situated in Manni-nadu a subdivision of Vadagarai-Rājendra-simha-vaļanađu.

cells.location: Tiru-kkuvaḷaṭṭai
cells.place: On the wall of Vēdapārīsvara. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions [Sirâ]ṇakan Siriya[v]ēḷar the general referred to in No. 291.

cells.place: On the wall of Vēdapārīsvara †
cells.remarks: Records of taxes belonging to the temple of Tirukkudittitai-Paramesvaram in Vaubayur alias So[samartanda-chaturvedimangalam, by the assembly of that village.

cells.location: Narkar-Periyanjuliyur
cells.place: On the north wall of the Kurrukkisvara temple
cells.remarks: Provision for the maintenance and supervision of an irrigation tank ut [suralar alias Sundara-Pandyanullor in Vayaraikka-nadu, which belonged to the temple of Kurakkkutti-Aludaiya-Nayanar.

cells.place: On the wall of Kurrukkisvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for the requirements of a festival named after the king, in the temple of Kurakkottai- Aludaiya-Nayanar the lord of Mogandur in Virasola-valandu alias Vanjiuvarakkanadu.

cells.location: Narkar-Periyanjuliyur
cells.place: On the wall of Kurrukkisvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of money for a lamp to the shrine of Vadaga-Pallaiyar in the temple of Kurakkottai- Aludaiyaar, the lord of Mogandur in Virasola-valanadu by a certain Setti suriamod Sersman. Tolan of Palainallur.

cells.location: Narkar-Periyanjuliyur
cells.place: On the wall of Kurrukkisvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land. Mentions Tirakkurakkuttali-Udaiyar.

cells.place: On the south wall of the Sugrīvīsvara temple at Sarkar Periyāpālayam.
cells.remarks: Refers to Sūralar alias Sundara-Pāndyanallūr which was a gift by Sundara-Pāndya to the temple of Korakkuttali-Nāyinār. Mentions also Siddakkārohi in Vayaraikka-nādu.

cells.place: On the wall of Sugrīvīsvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for off-erings.

cells.location: Māṅgāḍu, Saidapet taluk, Chingleput district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a pillar set up in the courtyard of Sugrīvīsvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land by a merchant (Satti) to the temple of Kurakkuttali-Sunbiranār the lord of Mugandapuram in Kailāsavāsa-chaturvedimangalam. Mentions the kavundas of Vadaparāsāra-nādu.

cells.place: On the west wall of the Varadarāja-Perumāl temple in the same village (as Sugrīvīsvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Mentions the temple of Peruma[]-Varadārāsar at Mugandanūr.

cells.place: On the west and south walls of the same temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Vikrāma40ja-chaturvēdimangalam and the temple of Vikrama-Chōja-Vinnagar[]var named after the king.

cells.location: Kuruvittugai
cells.place: On the west and south walls of Varadarāja-Perumāl temple. †
cells.remarks: Records that a native of Mañgādu, a village in Mañgādu-nādu in Puliyūr-kōttam, a district of Tondai-mandalam, made a gift of land for an offering and a treaty named Kulachēkaramangalam to the temple of Tiruchohakkarat- [a]lvar at Solantaka-chaturvēdimangalam in Pāganūr-kürram and registers an order of the king regarding certain changes to be made in these lands. Mentions Parakkirama-pāndiyan-kallanai. Confirms a previous grant to the Srivaisnavas of the temple, by order of Kalingarāyan.

cells.place: On the wall of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal †
cells.remarks: Confirms a previous grant made to the Srivaisbnavas of the temple, by order of Kālingarayan.

cells.location: Kuruvittugai
cells.place: On the wall of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal †
cells.remarks: Confirms a previous grant made to the Srivaisbnavas of the temple, by order of Kālingarayan.

cells.location: Kuruvittugai
cells.place: On the wall of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal †
cells.remarks: Gift of gold by a merchant of Keralāntakapuram in Nekkap-pai-nādu, for offerings to the image of Uyyakkondalvar set up by him in the temple of 'Paramasvāmin who was pleased to stand' at Tiruchohakkaratribham in Pāganūr-kūrram.

cells.place: On the wall of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal †
cells.remarks: Records that the grant mentioned in No. 319 was issued while the king was seated on his throne in the theatre inside his palace at Madura on the eastern side of Madakkulam.

cells.place: On the west wall of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of money for a lamp to the temple of god (emperumān) at Tiruchchakaranallur.

cells.location: Vāyalūr, Tiruvallur taluk, Chingleput district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west and south walls of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal temple. †
cells.remarks: Records that further changes were made in the lands granted under the name Kulāśēkharamaṅgalam by a native of Maṅgādu (see No. 318 above), on account of a mandapa built by the royal and reported by the assembly of Sojaṉēchchaturvdimangalam.

cells.place: On the south wall of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal temple †
cells.remarks: Registers the lease to a Brāhmaṇa of a specified temple-land in Kil-Chem-baṅ-gai-nādu, situated to the south of Paṭṭāki-kiramaṇḍiyan-kallanrai.

cells.place: On the wall of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal †
cells.remarks: Refers to the same lease which is here stated to have been made at the instance of Kalingaṅgēraṇ.

cells.place: On the south and east walls of the maṇḍapa in front of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged before the construction of a mandapa of which this is named after the king. The work is said to have been undertaken at the instance of a native of Tirunelvēli alias Kulāśēkharaṇallurvariydimangalam in Kilyenm-nādu.

cells.place: At the entrance into the kitchen of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal temple. †
cells.remarks: Mentions Srivallava-Viņṇagar. Below the inscription, is engraved an incomplete introduction beginning with the words tiru-maṅgal jayamangai, etc.

cells.place: On a pillar lying in the court-yard of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal temple †
cells.remarks: The pillar was the gift of Śirramba-[u]daiyan Pāndarāngi-Vānan.

cells.location: Kongar-Paḷiyaṅguḍi
cells.place: On the pedestal of one of the Jaina images on the hill
cells.remarks: Records that the image was cut at the instance of Guṇaśēṇappariyadigal, the pupil of Vaṭṭāmanava-Paṇḍitar who was the pupil of Gunaśēṇadēva presiding over Kuvaṇḍi-Tirukkāttampalli in Vequ-nādu.

cells.location: Koṅgar-Puḷiyaṅguḷam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the pedestal of another Jaina image on the hill
cells.remarks: The image was cut at the instance of a pupil of Guṇasēnadēva who was in charge of this paḷḷi.

cells.place: On the pedestal of the third Jaina image in the place of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Guṇasēnadēva who presided over this paḷḷi.
cells.also: <button type="button" class="xref-link" data-corpus="sii" data-key="sii|xii|i|244" data-url="SII-Inscriptions.html">SII Vol. XII Pt I, No. 244</button>

filters.also: Also in another book we hold

cells.location: Tiruparaṅkuṉṟam
cells.place: On the pillow-side of the Pañchapāṇḍava-beds on the eastern slope of the hill
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Guṇasēnadēva who presided over this paḷḷi.

cells.location: Aḻagar-malai
cells.place: On the pillow-side of one of the beds in the huge cavern known as Pañchapāṇḍava-beds on the hill
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Guṇasēnadēva who presided over this paḷḷi.

cells.location: Tiruvaḍiśūlam
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Jñānapurīśvara temple
cells.remarks: Gift of 12 sheep for a lamp to the temple of Āḷuḍaiyār Tiruviḍaichchuramuḍaiya-Nāyaṉār in Valla-nāḍu, a subdivision of Kaḷattūr-kōṭṭam in Jayaṅgoṇḍa-Chōḷa-maṇḍalam.

cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.remarks: Gift of the two villages of Perundeubākkam in Valla-nāḍu, a subdivision of Kaḷattūr-kōṭṭam and Mēl-Perundenbākkam in Āmūr-kōṭṭam.

cells.place: On the west wall of the same shrine ..
cells.remarks: Gift of money for offerings and lamps to the temple of Naduvaṟiyum-Tambirāṉār at Tiruviḍaichchuram by the mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Kumāra-Jalakarāja-Tirumalayadēva-Mahārāya, for the merit of the king. Mentions Seṅgaḻunīrpaṭṭu-sīrmai (i.e., the Chingleput country).

cells.place: On the west and south walls of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for two lamps.

cells.place: On the south wall of the same shrine ..
cells.remarks: Gift of 1½ sheep for a lamp by a native of Pulippakkam. Mentions Pallapuram in Puliyur-kōṭjam.

cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land in the village of Tiruviḍaichchuram to the temple of Tiruviḍaichchuram-Uḍaiyār, by a native of Kaḷattūr. Mentions Vallam alias Jayaṅgoṇḍaśōḻanallūr in Valla-nāḍu. Begins with the historical introduction pugaḻ-śūḻnda puviyiḻ, etc.

cells.location: Tiruvaḍiśūlam
cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.remarks: Gift of land.

cells.place: On the east wall of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal temple †
cells.remarks: Built in the beginning. Gift of 3 cows for a lamp. Mentions Pillaiyār Nilaigalägaṇiāiyar.

cells.place: On the wall of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal †
cells.remarks: Do. Mentions the districts Kalattur-parru, Tirukkalukkunra-pparru and Ayurva-pparru.

cells.place: On the west wall of the maṇḍapa in front of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal temple. †
cells.remarks: Some slabs on the right side of the inscription appear to have been removed and replaced by others. Gift of a lamp. Mentions Irendayirävoli-pparru in Kalattur-kötram.

cells.place: On the west wall of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal temple †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to record a gift of money. Records that a native of Perundandalum built a shrine and set up the image of the goddess Tirukamakāmudaiya-Periyānachchiyar in the temple of Tiruviräduhonchuramudaiya-Nāyanar.

cells.place: On the east wall of the Gövardhanamba] shrine in Chittarathavallabha-Perumal temple. †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Seems to record the gift of a lamp to the shrine of the same goddess.

cells.place: On the west wall of Chittarathavallabha-Perumal temple †
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning. Gift of money for a lamp by a certain Śivakāmavallabhan-Aṇḍanāttar. Mentions Mēgādayi Alagiyach-chōlanallur in Kuliyur-kōttam.

cells.location: Mänguḍu
cells.place: On the south wall of the central shrine in the Vallāvara temple
cells.remarks: Gift of money for a lamp to the temple of Tiruvelikilmöya-Nāyanar at Māngādu alias Alagiyasōlanallur in Puliyur-kōttam.

cells.place: On the wall of Vallāvara †
cells.remarks: Built in at the end. Seems to register a gift of land. Gift of gold for a lamp and offerings to the temple of Tiruvelikil. Mahādēva] at Mängādu by a native of Kachchibpēdu.

cells.location: Mänguḍu
cells.place: On the wall of Vallāvara †
cells.remarks: Inscription of ...., native of Kururattur and the temple of Tiruvelikilōdaiya

cells.location: Mänguḍu
cells.place: On the wall of Vallāvara †
On a slab built into the floor of Vallāvara temple. †
On another slab built into the same floor, Vallāvara temple. †

cells.location: Maṅgāḍu
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Kāmākshi-ammaṉ temple
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Āvuḍaiya-Nāchchiyār in Maṅgāḍu alias Aḻagiyaśōḻanallūr, in Maṅgāḍu-nāḍu a sub-division of Puliyūr-kōṭṭam, [alias] Kulōttuṅgaśōḻa-vaḷanāḍu in Jayaṅgoṇḍachōḷa-maṇḍalam. Mentions Dēvarāya-Uḍaiyār.

cells.place: On the west wall of Kamākshi-amman temple... †
cells.remarks: Registers an agreement among the villagers of Maṅgāḍu prohibiting the sale of lands to outsiders or even the gift of them as a dowry.

cells.place: On the south wall of the same shrine ..
cells.remarks: Sale of land to the temple of māṉṉaippuṟṟu Āvuḍai-Nāchchiyār in Maṅgāḍu. Puliyūr-kōṭṭam was otherwise named Kulōttuṅgaśōḷa-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the gopura of Kamākshi-amman temple, right of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift for the merit of Daḷavāy Śeñjāma-Nāyakkaṉ. Mentions Pūndamali-śīrmai.

cells.place: On a slab built into the floor in the gopura of Kamākshi-amman. †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Gift of a lamp. Maṅgāḍu is stated to have been situated in Puliyūr-kōṭṭam.

cells.place: On two stones built into the floor of the court-yard in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Gift of land as a paḷḷichchandam to a (pa)[ḷḷi] whose name is not quite distinct.

cells.place: On the east wall of the first prākāra of Kamākshi-amman temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Appears to record an agreement among the residents of Maṅgāḍu. Mentions Achchutappa-Nāyaka.

cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.remarks: Much damaged.

cells.place: On a pillar in the Māri-ammaṉ temple in the same village.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land to the temple of Parama-Nāyiṉār at Maṅgāḍu for the merit of Vīra-Narasiṅgarāya-Nāyakkar who appears to have been also called Śellappa.

cells.location: Vayalūr
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Vyāghrapurīśvara temple
cells.remarks: Gift of land for offerings to the temple of Tiruppiḷavayaluḍaiya-Nāyiṉār by Tarusi Timmarasar, son of Rāyatariśi Bommayadēva-Mahārāya who was a mahāmaṇḍalēśvara and bore the title Tribhuvanakaṭṭāri.

cells.place: On the west and south walls of Vyāghrapurīsvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Registers an agreement among the villagers of Vayalur that they will neither cultivate nor mortgage the lands belonging to the temple of Tiruppūlavaludaiya-Nāyaṉār and three others.

cells.place: On the south wall of Vyāghrapurīsvara temple †
cells.remarks: Registers that the weavers at Vayalur alias Jananāthanallūr in Eyil-nāḍu, a sub-division of Sembūr-kōṭṭam in Jayangoṇḍa-chōḻa-maṇḍalam, were taxed 3 paṇam on each loom.

cells.place: On a portion of the east wall of a partially demolished maṇḍapa in Vyāghrapurīsvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to register a grant in the village of Ārambakkam in Tirukkaluk-kunṟa-paṟṟu. Mentions Jananāthanallūr alias Vayalur in Ponmūr-nāḍu.

cells.place: On a slab built into the floor in the gōpura of Vyāghrapurīsvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for a lamp to the temple of Tiruppūlavaludaiyār in Ponmūr-nāḍu, a sub-division of Āmūr-kōṭṭam.

cells.place: On some detached stones built into the gōpura of Vyāghrapurīsvara. †
cells.remarks: Seems to record a sale of land.

cells.place: On a pillar in the gōpura of Vyāghrapurīsvara †
cells.remarks: Gives a long list of the kings of the Pallava dynasty who preceded Rājasimha.

cells.place: In the rock-cut cave (now used as a place of worship by the Muhammadans (near old Pallavaram).
cells.dynasty: Pallava †
cells.remarks: Contains the birudas of the Pallava king Mahēndravarman I.

cells.location: Neyvaṇai
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Svarpaghādēśvara temple
cells.remarks: Gift of paddy for offerings to the temple of Porkūḍangudutta-Nāyaṉār at Tiru-neḻvaṇai. Mentions the temple of Tiru-vaṇṇāmalaiuḍaiya-Nāyaṉār and the temple of Tiruviraṭṭāna-muḍaiya-Nāyaṉār in Tirukkōvalūr.

cells.place: On the wall of Svarpaghādēśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the god at Tirunel-veṇṇai in Kuṟukkai-kūṟṟam, a district in Milāḍu alias Jananātha-vaḷanāḍu, by Vikkiramachōḻa-Chēdiyarāyan of Kiliyūr. Mentions Kalaṭṭūr in Daṇḍa-nāḍu, a sub-division of Tirumuṉaippāḍi in Rājarāja-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Neyyanai
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Svarṇaghaṭēśvara temple
cells.remarks: Gift of land for lamps to the temple of Purkuḍangōdutarnīliya-Nāyanar at Tirunelvi-vayil in Aḍanur-nāḍu, a subdivision of Kulaṅkai-Kaikurram in Tirunarmunaippāḍi-nāḍu, by a native of Piḷampattīnam in Paṭṭana nāḍu, sub-division of Sembur-kōṭṭam in Jayangoṇḍachōla-maṇḍalam.

cells.place: On the wall of Svarṇaghaṭēśvara †
cells.remarks: Stones out of order. Gift of land for offerings to various shrines by Malaiyan-Mālan alias Rājēndrasōla-Malaiyānan of Kiliyūr.

cells.location: Neyyanai
cells.place: On the wall of Svarṇaghaṭēśvara †
cells.remarks: The end of the inscription is lost. Gift of lands under the name Sūngandavirtaśolanallur at the request of Porkōyil Londaiman, a native of Arumbākkam in Jayangondachola-mandalam.

cells.location: Neyyanai
cells.place: On the wall of Svarṇaghaṭēśvara †
cells.remarks: Refers to the setting up of the image of Naṭarāja (Kuṭṭāḍun-dēvar) in the temple at Tirunel-veyṇai by Rājēndrasōla-Chōled-yarāyan, a native of Kiliyūr which was situated in Tiru-muṇaippāḍi nāḍu, a subdivision of Gangakoṇḍachōla vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the west wall of Svarṇaghaṭēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of 34 cows for two lamps to the temple of Mahadēva at Tirunelvennai for the merit of Rajendraśola-Malaiyanan. Mentions Dāmar-kōṭtam on the southern bank of the Pepnai in Tirumunaippādi nādū, a subdivision of Rajendraśola-valanadū.

cells.place: On the wall of Svarṇaghaṭēśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged.

cells.place: On the south wall of Svarṇaghaṭēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of a ⅟₄ lamp.

cells.place: On the wall of Svarṇaghaṭēśvara †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Gift of land for offerings to the shrine of the goddess. Milāḍu is stated to be a sub-division of Rājajarāja-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the wall of Svarṇaghaṭēśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land in Paṉaippākkam under the name Kaḷikaḍinda-śōḻanallūr at the instance of Śivānandamahāmuni of Tiruttuṟaiyūr. Tirumuṉaippāḍi appears to have been otherwise called Rājēndraśōḷa-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the gōpura of the temple, right and left of entrance.
cells.remarks: Stones out of order. Refers to the victories of the king in the eastern country and to his remission of taxes in the villages owned by the Vaishṇava and other temples in the Chōḷa-maṇḍala.

cells.location: Tiruviḷimilalai

cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of land for festivities in connection with the two temples of Tiviḷimilalai-Uḍaiyār and the goddess Piḍāriyār. The latter of these was perhaps built in this year.

cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.remarks: Do. Mentions Tiruviḻimilalai which was a brahmadēya in Veṇṇāḍu, a subdivision of Uyyakkoṇḍaśōḷa-vaḷanāḍu. The donor was perhaps a native of Annavāyil in Śeṟṟūr-kūṟṟam, a district of Kulōttuṅgaśōḷa-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Tiruviḷimilalai
cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning. Gift of tiles covered with gold to the temple of Tiruviḷimiḻalai-uḍaiya-Mahādēva. One of the donors was Vijayarājēndradēva-Aṇukkiyār Pallavaṉ Paṭṭālinaṅgai.

cells.location: Tiruviḷimilalai
cells.place: On the wall of Viṛōdhīśvaram †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of land for a lamp, by purchase.

cells.location: Tiruviḷimilalai
cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.remarks: Gift of a lamp stand and a lamp.

cells.location: Tiruviḷimilalai
cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.remarks: Gift of money for two lamps. Mentions Āvūr-kūṟṟam, a district in Nittavinōda-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Tiruviḷimilalai
cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.remarks: Gift of land for offerings at the request of a native of Āvūr in Āvūr-kūṟṟam.

cells.location: Tiruviḷimilalai
cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.remarks: Gift of land in Taṭṭamaṅgalam for feeding Brāhmaṇas, at the request of the same person.

cells.location: Tiruviḻimiḻalai
cells.place: On the south wall of the central shrine in the Viḻinathasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Built in at the end. Refers to the gathering of the assembly of Tiruviḻimiḻalai, to discuss the business of the village (grāma-kārya).

cells.place: On the wall of Vilvanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Gift of a gold ornament.

cells.place: On the west wall of Vilvanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to a maṭha constructed at Tiruviḻimiḻalai and named Aḻagiya-Tiruchchiṟṟambalam-uḍaiyār-maḍam by a certain Jñānaśiva who was the disciple of Tiruchchaṭṭimuṟṟattu-Mudaliyār of the Tirujñānasambanda-tirumaḍam situated to the east of the temples of Tiruchchaṭṭimuṟṟamuḍaiya-Nāyaṉār and Tirukkāmakōṭṭamuḍaiya Periya-Nāchchiyār at Rājarājapuram in Tirunaṟaiyūr-nāḍu, a district of Kulōttuṅgachōḷa-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the west and south walls of Vilvanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Gives a detailed description of the boundaries of Jayaṅgoṇḍasōḷa-nallūr, the dēvadāna village of the temple at Tiruviḻimiḻalai, and refers to a survey of the lands belonging to the temple.

cells.remarks: Gift of land.

cells.place: On the south wall of Vilvanāthasvāmin temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for a garden by a merchant of Kāvērippūmpaṭṭinam in Rājādhirāja-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On one of the pillars in Vilvanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Records the name of Ukkal-kiḻāṉ-Edirilisōḻaṉ alias Pallavarājaṉ. Two other pillars bear the same name.

cells.place: On one of the door-posts in Vilvanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of a lamp.

cells.place: On the north wall of the first prākāra of Vilvanāthasvāmin temple. †

cells.remarks: Sale of land ty a native of Tiruvelundernādu in Jayahgondaśola-valanādu to a native of Nerkuppai in 1añjavūr-kōrram, a sub-division of Pandyakulaśani-valanādu.

cells.place: On the wall of Vilvanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Gift of land by a Brāhmaṇa for the merit of the king.

cells.place: On the wall of Vilvanāthasvāmin †

cells.location: Tiruviḻimiḻalai

cells.location: Tiruviḻimiḻalai

cells.location: Tiruviḻimiḻalai

cells.location: Tiruviḻimiḻalai

cells.location: Tiruviḻimiḻalai
cells.place: On the wall of Vilvanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Gift of land.

cells.location: Uyyakoṇḍān Tirumalai, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Tiruviljimilalai

cells.location: Tiruviljimilalai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Vilvanāthasvāmin †

cells.location: Tiruviljimilalai
cells.place: On the wall of Vilvanāthasvāmin †

cells.location: Tiruviljimilalai

cells.place: On a pillar in the inner veranda of Vilvanāthasvāmin temple. †

cells.place: On another pillar in the place of Vilvanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Begins with the usual historical introduction. Gift of paddy by the assembly of Tiruvillimilalai.

cells.location: Uyyakoṇḍān Tirumalai, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Fragment. Mentions Kōmāṇiṅgamaṅgalam of Puruṅgāranāḍu, a sub-division of Rājarājavāḷanāḍu.

cells.remarks: Gift of an ornament by a native of Viḷandai in Milalai-nāḍu, a sub-division of Vīraśōḷa-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the wall of Gaṇēśa †
cells.remarks: Mentions Vishṇuvardhanapuram, a village in Veṇṇāḍu, a sub-division of Uyyakkoṇḍār-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the south wall of Gaṇēśa shrine †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of a lamp.

cells.place: On the north wall of the Mahāsthānēśvara shrine in Gaṇēśa shrine. †
cells.remarks: Stones out of order. Refers to a sale of land. Another incomplete record of the same king is inscribed at the bottom.

cells.remarks: Gift of 36 sheep for a lamp to the temple of Tiruttanpróngi-bhatára at Tirumalalai in Vennadu.

cells.location: Tiruvilimilalai
cells.place: On the pillar of Saundaranāyaki †
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Gift of land for a flower-garden to the temple of Tiruttōṇṇōṇi-bhaṭāra at Tiruvilimiḻai.

cells.location: Tiruvilimilalai

cells.remarks: Gift of a sword (ea/) called Śrī-Kalakālen by Vaniyan Padan alias : rikalakésari Vilupparaiyan, to the temple of Tiruviljimilalai-Udsiyar.

cells.location: Tiruvilimilalai

cells.remarks: Gift of a silver dish to the temple of Tiruvilimiḻai-Uḍaiyār Parāmēśvara by...

cells.place: On the second pillar in Saundaranāyaki shrine †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of 20 sheep for a lamp to the temple of Tiruvagattivarapperumánadijga.

cells.location: Tiruvāṇaikkāval (Jambukēśvaram), Perambular taluk, Tiruchirappalli district — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Tiruvāṇaikkāval (Jambukēśvaram), Perambular taluk, Tiruchirappalli district — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Tiruvāṇaikkāval (Jambukēśvaram), Perambular taluk, Tiruchirappalli district — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Seems to record a gift by the monarch of a portion of the tax which villages belonging to the temple seem to provide for lamps.

cells.place: On the third gopura in Saundaranāyaki shrine, right of entrance. †

cells.location: Tirukkan-vassal
cells.place: On a pillar lying in a grove

cells.location: Uyyakkondan-Tirumalai

cells.place: On the south wall of Ujjīvanathasvāmīn temple †

cells.place: On the south wall of the prakara of Ujjīvanathasvāmīn †

cells.remarks: Gift of 90 sheep for a lamp by Irangolakkon alias Pogai-Vipparingan_dan A_vanivallan.
