cells.place: On the wall of Muṇḍīśvaramudaiyar †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Mentions Paṭṭavēdali-nallūr and adjacents to record a gift of lamp.

cells.place: On the south wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Amāhita-Perumāḷ temple in the same village (as Muṇḍīśvaramudaiyar temple). †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Kūnāviṇya-Viṇṇagar-Aḷvār built by Seyanda-māṇi-dāsa Kulasekharavarman at Māṇappadaiyūru.

cells.place: On the west wall of Amāhita-Perumāḷ temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of land.

cells.place: On the north wall of Amāhita-Perumāḷ temple. †
cells.remarks: Much damaged and incomplete. Begins with a historical introduction and mentions that Seyandamāṇi the founder of the temple of Bhagavatī-servants (of the King?)

cells.location: Suta-malli
cells.place: On the south wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Bhagavatīśvara temple
cells.remarks: Gift of land in the village of Kudaikkalam the western hamlet of Śeravanmadevi-chaturvēdimangṣlam in Mulji-nādu, to the temple of Bhagavati[ī]śvaram-[udaiyar] at Suttamali alias Viravinoda-chaturvēdimangṣlam in Mēl-Vēmba-nādu. Mentions Manabharanamaṅgalam.

cells.place: On the west wall of the central shrine in Bhagavatīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land in the same village, under orders from Kōṇērinmaikoṇḍān.

cells.place: On the wall of Bhagavatīśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of money for a lamp.

cells.place: On the north wall of Bhagavatīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of 100 dīnāras by the king for the lamp in the tank Kulasekharappērēri at Suttamalli alias Vīra-Pāṇḍya-chaturvēdimangalam, on representations made by a Brahmana of Karambichchankuḍi. Refers to the maṇḍapa called Pōgabhāgaraṇan in the palace at Maḍaikkulakīl-Madurai.

cells.place: On the wall of Bhagavatīśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for offerings in the village of Rājarāja-chaturvēdimangalam in Muḷi-nāḍu. One of the signatories was a native of Kuḍichchankuḍi.

cells.location: Suta-malli
cells.place: On the wall of Bhagavatīśvara †
cells.remarks: Records that the order was issued by the king while he was seated on Muṇai-dar-Iśvara in the palace at Maḍaikkulakīl-Madurai. The signatories were a native of Kuḍichchankuḍi. [The village] was one of Villa-tūr alias Jayangoṇḍaśōḷanallūr in Kalakkuḍi-nāḍu, a sub-division of Miḷalai-kūṛṛam, and others.

cells.place: On the south and west walls of the Saundarāja-Perumāḷ temple in the same village (as Bhagavatīśvara temple) †
cells.remarks: Much damaged and fragmentary. Contains portions of the historical intro-duction commencing with pū-maruviya, of Māṛavarman Sundara-Pāṇḍya-dēva. Gift of money for a lamp.

cells.place: On the south wall of a Śiva temple on the bank of the Āmarapaṇi river in the same village.
cells.remarks: Records that king Vira-Kōrali Kulaśekharadēva made, for the merit of his son, a gift of land to the Bhattas of Udayamattāṇda-chaturvēdimangṣlam. The land was situated in kōndāṇr alias Kulaśekhara-chaturvēdimangṣlam of Mēl-Vēmba-nādu, on the southern side of the temple of Āṇgundīsvaram-Udaiya; which is stated to be an dṛrayalinga subordinate to the temple at Vrihivriti (Tinnevelly).

cells.place: On the north wall of the same temple.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Appears to record a gift of land to the sbrine of the goddess, built in the temple of Angundīvarmundaiya-Nayaṇīr, by Sirvanlokakalaṇ alias Sembiyadaraiyan.

cells.location: Alyar-Tirunagari
cells.place: On the north wall of Saundarāja-Perumāḷ temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of the two villages of Seṭangkulam and Neduṅgulam, hamlets of Tirukkurugūr in Tiruvajudivalanādu, by a certain Odanattadigal for feeding the learned men of the 'eighteen (vachinava) countries' who met in the Arulajadisan matha founded by himself in the temple of Polinjininparuliya-Paramasvāmi at Tirukkurugūr. Mentions Sirvaikundam alias Rājendra-chaturvedimangalam, Tiruvaymojimamuni a disciple of Tirukkurugārmānumi and the palace of the king situated in a grove south of Jayangondaśolapuram.

cells.place: On the wall of Ādi-nātha. †
cells.remarks: Records the sanction of the above gift by Kaliṅgarāyan.

cells.place: On the north wall of the shrine of Ādi-nātha. †
cells.remarks: Gift of special privileges by Tribhuvanachakravartin Koṇērimēṇ-koṇḍāṉ, in the distribution of the sacred prasāda, to a Brāhmaṇa of Maṇalūr who recited the purāṇas and vēdas in the temples of Poṉṉiṉ-Aruḷāḷa-Paramēśvaran and Tirunāḷaippōvār at Tirunāṅgūr in Tiruvāḷī-nāḍu.

cells.place: On the wall of Ādi-nātha †
cells.remarks: Records that Ariciyan Virudhamōhiraṉ alias Pallavarāyar of Chakrapāṇi-nallūr in Śavviruṅkāṉāḍu, built the maṇḍapa and set up the image of Varāha-Ṇāyaṉār.

cells.location: Alyar-Tirunagari
cells.place: On the wall of Ādi-nātha †
cells.remarks: Gift of land at Peruṅgulam alias Uttama-Pāndyanallur, with the sanction of Majavarāyan, for a festival founded in the temple at Tirukkurugūr by Araiyan Pōvaṇ alias Venāvudaiyān, in the name of Araiyan Tirunādudaiyān alias Nilagangaraiyān of Kilai-Kodumalar in Vadatalai Seubi-nādu. Mentions the palace at Mādakkulukkil-Madurui and the seat, Majavarāyan.

cells.location: Alyar-Tirunagari
cells.place: On the wall of Ādi-nātha †
cells.king: Māṛavarman alias Tribhuvanachakravartin Sundara-Pāṇḍyadēva †
cells.remarks: Gift of land at Śrīvaikuṇṭam alias Rājēndra-chaturvēdimangalam for the upkeep of the same festival.

cells.location: Alyar-Tirunagari
cells.place: On the wall of Ādi-nātha †
cells.remarks: I complete. Gift of land at Peruṅguḷam alias Uttama-Pāṇḍyanallūr, for the same purpose.

cells.place: On the north wall of the yāgaśālā in the temple of Ādi-nātha. †
cells.remarks: The two verses written by Kavipitamaha record that Malavanripati built an artistic māndapa for the god Schitadipati—(Ninra-) Adinātha (in Tamil)—also called 'lata, at 'Tātaśrimagari (i.e. Alyār-Tirunagari?). Damaged. Mentions Veṇrumankonda Bōtalavira sri-Udayamattāṇdapanmar.

cells.place: On the main gōpura of the temple of Ādi-nātha, left of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Veṇrumankonda Bōtalavira sri-Udayamattāṇdapanmar.

cells.location: Edirkōtiai
cells.place: On a rock close to the Sumai-Kaṅthosevara temple
cells.remarks: Damaged. Muṇṭōṉa Veḻaikkāḻ-nāḍu and appears to record a gift of sheep for a lamp.

cells.place: On the rock of Sīmā-i-Kaṇṭhēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Records a gift to the temple of Supaikkukdi-Pudārar and mentions Kōttankūdi in Venbaikkudi-nādu.

cells.location: Bezwāda, Bezwada taluk, Kistna district — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the south wall of the Veṇugōpālasvāmin temple in the same village (as Sīmā-i-Kaṇṭhēśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. In continuation of this slab, is a fragment in Vatṭe'luttu characters which records a portion of the historical introduction of Kajaraja I. and the 22nd year of his reign.

cells.location: Koṇḍavīḍu, Narasaraopet taluk, Guntur district — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the west wall of Veṇugōpālasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. In continuation of this, is a fragment of a Pāṇḍya inscription in Tamil characters.

cells.place: On the north wall of Veṇugōpālasvāmin temple †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Begins with the historical introduction tirumagal, etc. Mentions Nārāyaṇa-Viṇṇagarattār.

cells.place: On a slab set up to the east of the same village (as Veṇugōpālasvāmin temple) †
cells.remarks: Damaged and unfinished. Gift of land to the temple of Kulanagaikkavalis-varamudaiya-Nāyanār at Pullanaikkuruchohi a dēvadīna village of Vikramapandīs-varamudaiya-Nāyanār at Venbaikkudi in Venbaikkudi-nādu.

cells.place: On the west wall of the ruined Śiva temple
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Appears to record a gift of land to the shrine of the goddess in the temple of Sundarapāṇḍyavīśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyaṇār.

cells.place: On the north wall of Śiva temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for offerings, to the temple of Sundarapandīs-varamudaiya-Nāyanār at Maramangalam alias Sundarapandyanallār in Karunilakkudi-nādu.

cells.location: Soḻapuram
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Vikrama-Pāṇḍyēśvara temple
cells.remarks: Gift land. Records the one of the kukkūḷars of the temple of Chintā-maṇinātha at Vāśiḍi (dēvadāna in Āriyānāḍu), was appointed the manager of this land.

cells.place: On the wall of Vikrama-Pāṇḍyīśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to a Mudaliyar who was originally manager in the temple of Tiruvāḷavāy-Uḍaiyār at Maḍakkalāyi-k-Kūḍal-Mādurai, in Maḍurōdaya-vaḷa-nāḍu and was appointed manager of the temple account under orders from prince Alagap-Perumāḷ Arivirattarman.

cells.location: Soḻapuram — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the wall of Vikrama-Pāṇḍyīśvara †
cells.remarks: Unfinished.

cells.place: On the north wall of the same veran-dah.

cells.location: Karempudi, Palnad taluk, Guntur district — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a pillar in the maṇḍapa at the en-trance into Vikrama-Pāṇḍyīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of the pillar by an individual who prayed for a son.

cells.remarks: Gift of subscriptions to the temple by the merchants of certain specified villages, at the rate of 3rd papam on each cloth which they sold.

cells.place: In the place of Vikrama-Pāṇḍyīśvara †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records that the Mahādēvas of the temple agreed to conduct a festival from the rent realised on a house built [by it], by a private individual.

cells.place: On the outer main gōpura of Vikrama-Pāṇḍyīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Records that this gōpura was [built] by Sundara-Pāṇḍya.

cells.place: On the wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Vaḍakkalāy-Perumāḷ temple in the same village (as Vikrama-Pāṇḍyīśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Fixes the boundaries of Sundarapāṇḍyavīśvaramuḍaiyamaṅgalam which was the dēvadāna village of the temple of Sundarapāṇḍya-Viṇṇagar-Āḷvār under orders from prince [piḷḷaiyār] Saudara-Pāṇḍyadēva while he was staying at Ārgaikkurattūr in Āriyā-nāḍu.

cells.place: On the wall of Vaḍakkalāy-Perumāḷ †
cells.remarks: Refers to a maṇḍapa, a portion which was built by Uḍaiyar Kaḷyāḷar in the temple of Aḷagiyamanavāḷa-Emberumān in Aḷma-nāḍu and to Uttama-śōḷa-Chaturvēdimangalam.

cells.location: Soḻapuram
cells.place: On the wall of Vaḍakkalāy-Perumāḷ †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of money for lamps.

cells.location: Soḻapuram
cells.place: On the wall of Vaḍakkalāy-Perumāḷ †
cells.remarks: Gift of taxes to the temple of Uttamasōla-Vinnagar-Ālvar in Āmna-nādu.

cells.location: Soḻapuram
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Records that a certain Viran Kōlangariyān alias Veṇavudaiyān of Kalattarūr alias Ongalakrtinallar in Sevvirukkai-nādu, built in the temple of Uttamasōla-Vinnagar-Ālvar, the following mandapas,—(1) Antarāla-mandapa to the east of the Ardha-mandapa in which the Perumā] and Mannanār were seated and (2) Mahā-mandapa in front of it with the sōpāna (i.e. steps) (on either side of it?).

cells.location: Chintapalli, Palnād taluk, Guntur district — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the lintel of the main entrance into Vaḍakkalāy-Perumāḷ temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Uttamaśōḷa-Viṇṇagar.

cells.place: On the east wall of Vaḍakkalāy-Perumāḷ temple, right of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Uttamaśōḷa-Viṇṇagar.

cells.place: In the place of Vaḍakkalāy-Perumāḷ †
cells.remarks: Built in, at the end. Gift of land to the shrine of Sundarapāṇḍya-Viṇṇagar-Āḷvār, built by Nācciyār Nambiyāṇḍār in the temple of Uttamaśōḷa-Viṇṇagar-Āḷvār.

cells.place: On the wall of Vaḍakkalāy-Perumāḷ left of entrance †
cells.remarks: A duplicate copy of No. 498.

cells.place: In the place of Vaḍakkalāy-Perumāḷ †
cells.king: Māṛavarman alias Tribhuvanachakravartin Kuḷaśēkharadēva who was pleased to take every country.
cells.remarks: Gift of land for offerings.

cells.location: Puduppaḷaiyam
cells.place: On the south wall of the Paṛaṇṇangattaruḷiyavāmin temple
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Appears to record a gift of money for a lamp.

cells.place: On the east wall of Paṛaṇṇangattaruḷiyavāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Refers to the palace at Maḍakkulakkīl, Madurai and to the seat called Māja-śrī-kōyil and seems to register a gift of land for feeding sacrifices.

cells.place: On the lintel of the entrance into Paṛaṇṇangattaruḷiyavāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Records that the door-posts and the step-stones were the gift of Śrīvala-Pāṇḍyadēva.

cells.place: On the main gōpura of the Viśvanātha temple at Tenkāśi, left of entrance.
cells.remarks: Records that Perumāḷ Māṛa Parākrama-Pāṇḍya, died called Parākrama-Pāṇḍya, died in this year.

cells.place: In the same place
cells.remarks: Records that kin chi Arikesari Parakrama repaired the central shrine in this year by removing (karshanai) the god from its original place and reconscreated it, in Śaka 1369.

cells.location: Puduppaḷaiyam
cells.place: In the same place
cells.remarks: Records that Nāivēl Marau Yiravēl Kuḷaśēkhara-Sōḷiyan also called Poṇṇan Paṇḍiyan was owned in this year and that a tiru-viḷakkamaḍai was com-posed in honour of the occasion.

cells.location: Puduppaḷaiyam
cells.place: In the same place
cells.remarks: Records that a certain Aḷagan Śivalavēl was crowned in this year.

cells.location: Puduppaḷaiyam
cells.place: In the same place
cells.remarks: In praise of the nine storeyed gōpura which was built by Perumāḷ-Vaḷadi.

cells.location: Puduppaḷaiyam
cells.place: In the same place
cells.remarks: Record that the foundation (upāna) for the tower was laid in this year under the direction of king Vaĵud[i]-Parakrama.

cells.place: On the gopura of Viśvanātha, right of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Records that Vaṭivīraman alias Abhirāman gave (?) to Kaśikkaliyāṇa Kavi-rayan the village-Aṇumaṇigālam, Kuḍaimāḷgālam and Vaṇamaṅgalam.

cells.place: On the place of Viśvanātha †
cells.remarks: In praise of Purākrama-Pandya.

cells.location: Puduppaḷaiyam
cells.place: On the place of Viśvanātha †
cells.remarks: Records that Aḻagu Kulaśēkhara completed the gōpura which had been left unfinished by his brother (omitted?).

cells.location: Puduppaḷaiyam
cells.place: On the place of Viśvanātha †
cells.remarks: Records that taxes collected, by mistake, at Viśvanāthanallūr were returned to the temple and that the village was confirmed as a sarvamānya to the same temple.

cells.location: Puduppaḷaiyam
cells.place: On the place of Viśvanātha †
cells.remarks: Three verses in praise of Vīra-Pāṇḍyan Abhirāman, who conquered Viḷḷavan and captured Vaḷḷam. The king also seems to have borne the surname Vīramāran Śaḷiyan.

cells.location: Puduppaḷaiyam
cells.place: On the place of Viśvanātha †
cells.remarks: Refers to the charities of Kōpthai Parākrama Māran also called Parākrama-Pāṇḍya and Arikēsari, in the temple of Viśvanātha.

cells.location: Puduppaḷaiyam
cells.place: On the place of Viśvanātha †
cells.remarks: Records the gift mentioned in No. 515.

cells.location: Puduppaḷaiyam
cells.place: On the place of Viśvanātha †
cells.remarks: Records that Parākrama-Pandya also called Parākramakkaitavan Mānakayachan Korkkaivendan Arikesari and Pongnin-Perumal finished the work of the göpura in 6 years and died.

cells.place: On the west wall of the mandapa in front of the central shrine in Viśvanātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land in Nallūr-puram, a sub-division of Tenkarai-nāḍu, to Taṭṭy-pra-kāśan one of the religious teachers living in the street called Vīrarāma-gōpura, west of the temple.

cells.location: Māchērla, Palnad taluk, Guntur district — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the north wall of Viśvanātha temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of land in the same division to the shrine of the goddess Uḷagamunḷu-muḍaiya-Nācciyār.

cells.place: On the wall of Viśvanātha †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for offerings.

cells.location: Puduppaḷaiyam
cells.place: On the wall of Viśvanātha †
cells.remarks: Refers to the works done in connection with the temple (from the gōpura up to the steps) and the gōpura, by Arikēsari-dēva alias Parākrama-Pāṇḍyadēva and states that the king built the river Chittāru in Tenkarai-nāḍu.

cells.location: Puduppaḷaiyam — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the wall of Viśvanātha †
cells.remarks: Provides for offerings in a shrine of Viṣṇu built by Tiravali Śuṅgāram-bhaṭṭar-Brahmādhirāyan within the prākāra of the temple at Taṅkāśi, which was situated on the northern bank of the river Chittāru in Tenkarai-nāḍu.

cells.location: Puduppaḷaiyam
cells.place: On the wall of Viśvanātha †
cells.king: Jaṭilavarman alias Tribhuvanachakra-vartin Kōnērinmaikoṇḍān Perumāḷ Kulaśēkharadēva
cells.remarks: Damaged. The king receives the usual dues of the latter Pāṇḍyas. Seems to record a gift of land.

cells.place: On the east wall of Viśvanātha temple, right of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to a servant of the temple. Refers to a gift of offerings made to the shrine of the goddess by prince (?) Veṇpaimāḷ-iṭa-Perumāḷ Vīra Pāṇḍyadēva.

cells.location: Miriyala, Palnad taluk, Guntur district — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the north wall of the verandah round Viśvanātha temple. †
cells.king: Perumāḷ Tirunelvēli-pperumāḷ Dharmma-Perumāḷ alias Tribhuvanachakra-vartin Kōnērinmaikoṇḍān Abhirāma-Parākrama Pāṇḍyadēva.
cells.remarks: The king is said to have possessed a Vīrarāma-maḍai. Refers to prince (?) Aḻagan-Perumāḷ Abhirāraman.
cells.also: <button type="button" class="xref-link" data-corpus="sii" data-key="sii|xxvi||621" data-url="SII-Inscriptions.html">SII Vol. XXVI, No. 621</button>

cells.place: On the wall of Viśvanātha †
cells.king: Jaṭāvarman alias Tribhuvanachakravartin Konērinmaikoṇḍān Perumāḷ Aḷagapperumāḷ, Aivārurāṇum alias Śrīvallabhadēva.
cells.remarks: Refers to the order of prince Abhirāmadēvar Śrī-Varaguṇarājan and records a gift of land, a house, and a garden to Viśvanātha-Muḍaiyār-Uḍaiyār.

cells.location: Puduppaḷaiyam
cells.place: On the wall of Viśvanātha †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Gift of a house to a maṭha at Tenkāśi. Refer to the repairs executed to the temple by king Parākrama-Pāṇḍyadēva.

cells.place: On the slab set up in front of the gōpura in Viśvanātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Refers to the repairs to the temple executed by Ponninperumāḷ Parākrama-Pāṇḍyadēva.

cells.place: On a quadrangle pillar set up in the place of Viśvanātha. †
cells.king: Jatīlavarman alias Tribhuvanachakravartin Perumāl Arikṣsaridēva alias Pongniperumāl Purākrama-Pāndyadēva.
cells.remarks: Records that in Śaka 1368 the ākurshapu ceremony was performed and in the 2nd + 22nd year the work of repair was commenced and was continued till the 31 + 9th i.e., for 17 years. All the grants made to the temple are also registered.

cells.location: Palliguṇṭa, Palnad taluk, Guntur district — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the south wall of the central shrine in the Perumāḷ-Perumāḷ temple in the same village (as Viśvanātha temple) †
cells.remarks: Refers to a gift made by Vīravanḍiyar Tiruvēṅkaṭaipuram to a servant of the temple.

cells.place: On the north wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Kuḷaśēkharamuḍaiyār temple in the same village (as Perumāḷ-Perumāḷ temple). †
cells.king: Jaṭāvarman alias Tribhuvanachakravartin Konērinmaikoṇḍān Perumāḷ Aḷagapperumāḷ, Aivārurāṇum alias Śrīvallabhadēva.
cells.remarks: Sale of land by the Bhaṭṭas of Puliyūr Parākrama-Pāṇḍya-chatravēdi-maṅgalam in the Tenkāśi-nāḍu, to the temple of Kuḷaśēkharamuḍaiyār-Nāyaṉār at Kuḷaśēkharanallūr, in the same district.

cells.king: Jaṭāvarman alias Tribhuvanachakravartin Konērinmaikoṇḍān Perumāḷ Aḷagapperumāḷ, Aivārurāṇum alias Śrīvallabhadēva.
cells.remarks: Refer to the building of the temple and the consecration of the god Kuḷaśēkharanātha and the goddess Kuḷaśēkharamuḍai-Nāchchiyār and registers a gift of land for repairs and offerings.

cells.place: On the west wall of the central shrine in Kuḷaśēkharamuḍaiyār temple. †
cells.king: Jaṭāvarman alias Tribhuvanachakravartin Konērinmaikoṇḍān Perumāḷ Aḷagapperumāḷ, Aivārurāṇum alias Śrīvallabhadēva.
cells.remarks: Refer to the building of the temple and the consecration of the god Kuḷaśēkharanātha and the goddess Kuḷaśēkharamuḍai-Nāchchiyār and registers a gift of land for repairs and offerings.

cells.location: Bezwada — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the mutilated slab dug in the court-yard of the Mallēśvarasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Registers some legends in connection with the Mallēśvara temple and refers to the chief as being born in the family of king Kaḍava [t] and being subordinate to the Chāḷukya king of Veṅgīdēśa.

cells.location: Koṇḍavīḍu
cells.place: On a pillar of a ruined maṇḍapa on the top of the hill
cells.remarks: Two short Telugu inscriptions on other pillare in the same temple, refer to the building of a mandapa, and name the god Narasinhadēva and Lakshmi-pati.
cells.also: <button type="button" class="xref-link" data-corpus="sii" data-key="sii|xxvi||634" data-url="SII-Inscriptions.html">SII Vol. XXVI, No. 634</button>

cells.place: On a pillar of a ruined mandapa called Varahalakoṭtu on the same hill.
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Records that the king's treasurer (Bhaṇḍāri) Dāmana set up a pillar in the temple of Viśvēśvara for the merit of his maternal uncle Rāna-sāhi surnamed Rājyavābhī-Choḍa.

cells.place: On a beam of Mallēśvarasvāmin temple †
cells.remarks: Records that a certain Dāmalapāti Chēmanamingāru presented the stone beam in the gōpura of the Viśvēśvara temple, for the merit of his spiritual teacher Śrīgira-ayyaṅgāru who was the grandson (f) of Paṇḍita-Ārādhya-dēva.

cells.place: On another beam of Mallēśvarasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Twelve other short Telugu epigraphs not dated, on pillars and beams of the same mandapa, record that these latter were presented to the temple of Viśveśvara by certain merchants and Reddis.

cells.location: Atmakūru
cells.place: On a slab near the Dargi temple on the top of the hillock
cells.king: Mahāmaṇḍaleśvara Kulli Peda-kōṭa Voḍeyalu, Tirumalarāya Pādāśaha.
cells.remarks: Records the conquests of the king's father in Śaka 1502 and the suppression of certain rebellious chiefs in Koṇḍavīḍu-sīma.

cells.place: On the wall, right of entrance into the central shrine of Dargi temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of a village to the temple of Darga-Paramēśvari of Mullangūri-Śakti by a certain Nagapa-yantragāra.

cells.place: On a boulder called Pullaribanda in the same village (as Dargi temple). †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Records that Peda-Tirumalayyāḍēva Mahārājulu of the Peda-Sulika family, built a tank and planted a garden both of which he presented to the temple of Gōpinātha at Yeluūru, in Koṇḍavīḍu.

cells.location: Vēmalūrpāḍu
cells.place: On a pillar lying near the Śiva temple
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of land to the temple of Gōpinātha at Juvvalakalu in Bellam-konda. Also records a record, dated in the same temple of Gōpinātha, that a gift of land was made to it. Another slab in the same place records that a few years later the temple of Gōpalasvāmi and Bhīmēśvara at Juvvalakalu were repaired and reconsented.

cells.remarks: Gift of land by a certain Ambarāju to the temple of Mūlasthānam-Bhīma-nāthasvāmin at Juvvalakalu.

cells.location: Kārempūḍi
cells.place: On a pillar of the mandapa in front of the Sōmēśvara temple
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Sōmēśvaradēva by the king's subordinate Gauḍa-pendāru Māḍeyarāju. Also records the building of the gōpura and the prākāra wall by a private individual.

cells.place: On another pillar of Sōmēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the same temple by Allavatam Peddaya.

cells.place: On the third pillar in the place of Sōmēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Records the building of the temple of Sōmēśvara by Ianna-Peggada, a minister of the king, at Kārempūḍi and a grant to it of 50 goats for a lamp. Ianakūṭi and Kalyāṇadatti are mentioned as the arkhaspatis of the temple.

cells.place: On a slab set up in the courtyard of the Aṅkāḷamma temple in the same village (as Sōmēśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Mentions [the goddess] Vindhyavād and the ardhapari Kalyāṇśakti, referred to in No. 552.

cells.place: On a slab set up in the courtyard of the Chennakēśavasvāmi temple in the same village (as Aṅkāḷamma temple). †
cells.remarks: Records that the temple of Chennakēśavasvāmi which was formerly built by the heroes (vīrulu) in the town of Kārampūṇḍi alias Uddandarāyapuram (?), had become dilapidated and the image of the god mutilated. A servant of Adisambali Rāmānayaningāru renovated the temple and the images, together with those of the Ālvārs and made grants of land for offerings.

cells.place: On a beam of the tower called Nāyudumēḍa in the middle of the same village (as Chennakēśavasvāmi temple). †
cells.remarks: Records the erection of the tower (mēḍa) by Jīrambha Timma, son of the latter's son, are all figured on the beam, some holding spears and others standing in a worshipping posture.

cells.place: On a slab set up in the courtyard of the temple of Hēra (?) Vīrula-guḍi in the same village (as Chennakēśavasvāmi temple). †
cells.remarks: Records a decision of the Śrī-Vaishnava teacher Nallijānu Gōvindachakra-vartti Ayyan-gāru, regarding certain pedārī-vīrulu and set up the Garuḍastambha.

cells.place: On a pillar of the temple of Hēra †
cells.remarks: Mentions Anantagōpāla-śvara (?), the lord of Ayōdhya and appears to record that a merchant built the temple for the vīrulu and set up the Garuḍastambha.

cells.place: On a slab set up in the field adjoining the temple of Hēra. †
cells.remarks: Records that the slab was set up by a merchant for the merit of his teacher who was an dradḍhya.

cells.location: Chintapalli
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Añjanēya temple
cells.remarks: Refers to the building of the temple and to a gift of land.

cells.place: On a pillar set up in front of the Doḍḍa-Mallēśvara temple in the same village (as temple of Hēra). †
cells.remarks: Records that a certain Painḍi Marreḍḍi erected the shrine of Muktēśvara in the temple of Doḍḍa-Mallēśvara at Chintapalli, for the merit of his father Bīra Muttir [e]ḍḍi.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram, Tanjore taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab forming the wall of a small shrine in the courtyard of Doḍḍa-Mallēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the same shrine by [Ma]bayanayaningāru for the merit of the king.

cells.remarks: Records that a certain Mantraya is stated to have built (i.e., renovated?) the temple of Doḍḍa-Mal[l]ikarjuna.

cells.remarks: Records the setting up of the Garudastambha by a certain Paluta Vōban-nāngāru.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram, Tanjore taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab set up in the courtyard of the Vīrēśvara temple at Macharla, in the same village (as Mādhavasvāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: Mutlated. Gift of the village Lingāpura to the temples of Vīrēśvara and Iśhāna [īśvara] at Macharla, by the queen of Kōmāra Timmā-Nāinīngāru of the Rōcharla-gōtra.

cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Pōlē-ramma temple in the same village (as Vīrēśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Provides for offerings to the temple of C[an]ga Parammāvari.

cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the ruined "temple of heroes" on the bank of the Chandravanka stream, in the same village (as Pōlē-ramma temple). †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for the benefit of the heroes (vīrapurushulu), while Devari-Nay-inīgāru was ruling Mahādevicharla.

cells.location: Adigōppala — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab fixed into the wall of the Añjanēya temple
cells.remarks: Records the building of the temple by a private person and a gift of land to it.

cells.place: On a slab of Ganapati in Pōlē-ramma temple. †
cells.remarks: The image was caused to be made by Konara-Doohaya, son of Divakara-Peggada, while he was [ruling] Adigōppala.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram, Tanjore taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab built into the wall of the Tripurāntakēśvara temple in the same village (as Pōlē-ramma temple). †
cells.remarks: Mentions that the temple was built by Aṅkakana-Vīranna.
cells.also: <button type="button" class="xref-link" data-corpus="sii" data-key="sii|xxvi||696" data-url="SII-Inscriptions.html">SII Vol. XXVI, No. 696</button>

cells.location: Miriyāla
cells.place: On a slab near the platform of the flag staff, in front of the Channa-kēśava temple
cells.remarks: Records the building of the platform and the setting up of the pillar on it by a certain Pōtīndu, while he was ruling Miriyāla.

cells.place: On a pillar lying by the road side in the village of Charigonda.
cells.remarks: Records that a certain Minugu Malla-[Nayinigaru] (with a long list of titles), ratified grants to gods and Brahmans in Cherlagudipađu in Gurindalaśima.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram, Tanjore taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab built into the platform of the flag-staff, in the Vēṇugōpālas-vāmin temple in the same village (as Channa-kēśava temple). †
cells.remarks: Records the building of the platform and the setting up of the flagstaff. Mentions a certain China-Vallamāyūri of the Ātrēya-gōtra.

cells.place: On the west wall of the central shrine of Vēṇugōpālas-vāmin temple †
cells.remarks: Mentions the learned men of Gudipādu and two other individuals.

cells.place: On a slab near a well outside the same village (as Vēṇugōpālas-vāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: Records the digging of the well in front of the temple of Kajēśvara.

cells.location: Palligunta
cells.place: On a mutilated pillar of white stone in the Śiva temple
cells.remarks: Mentions Pulikallu.

cells.location: Gurizala
cells.place: On the Nāga pillar in the Vīra-bhadrēśvara temple
cells.remarks: Mentions Mādhav-pattana and records a gift of land by a Haihaya chief to the temple of the Hindu trinity.

cells.place: On a slab set up near the platform of the flag-staff, in the courtyard of Vīra-bhadrēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Srīantharāju Rāmayadeva-Mahārāja ratified grants to gods and Brāhmaṇas in the Gurindala-sīma.

cells.place: On three eirukais in front of the Gurisalamna temple, 1 mile south of the same village (as Vīra-bhadrēśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Damaged.

cells.place: On a mutilated slab set up in the village of Pidugurāla.
cells.remarks: Appears to record the consecration of a temple for Rāma and Lakshmaṇa of Ayōdhya.

cells.location: Mōtupalle
cells.place: On a pillar of the maṇḍapa in front of the Vīrabhadrasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Remission of taxes on articles of export and import [at the harbour of] Mōtupalli alias Dēśayyakkoṇḍapaṭṭaṇa.

cells.place: On another pillar of Vīrabhadrasvāmin temple †
cells.remarks: Refers to a concession given to the merchants on sea.

cells.place: On the pillar of Vīrabhadrasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Refers to a concession given to the merchants on sea.

cells.place: On the east wall of Vīrabhadrasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Records gifts by private persons of sheep or cows to the temple of Pāṭalīśvara-Nāyaṇār.

cells.place: Round the base of the central shrine of the Koḍuṇḍārāmasvāmin temple in the same village (as Vīrabhadrasvāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: Gift of a lamp to the temple of Gōpīnatha, consecrated in the year Durmati by the merohant Dharmarāma-Seṭṭi.

cells.place: On a pillar lying in front of Koḍuṇḍārāmasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of sheep for a lamp to the temple of Prasannakeśava at Moṭṭupa[li] alias Deśayyuṇḍavaṭṭana, by a native of Eḍohuvaka in Toṇḍai-maṇḍalam.

cells.place: On the pillar of Koḍuṇḍārāmasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Gift of sheep &c. to the temple of Gaṇapati-Prasannakeśavadeva at Moṭṭupalli, [for] Śrīmad-Velluṅgāra for the merit of the Kākati King Gaṇapadeva-Mahārāja.

cells.location: Mōtupalle — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the pillar of Koḍuṇḍārāmasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Gift of land.

cells.location: Mōtupalle — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the pillar of Koḍuṇḍārāmasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Gift of cows for a lamp by a cowherd of Moṭṭupalli, to the temple of Pra[sa]-nṇakeśavadeva.

cells.location: Mōtupalle
cells.place: On the pillar of Koḍuṇḍārāmasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Gift of cows for the merit of King Rudradeva-Mahārāja.

cells.location: Mōtupalle
cells.place: On the pillar of Koḍuṇḍārāmasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Gift of money for a stone-maṇḍapa in the temple of [Prasanna]keśava-deva.

cells.location: Jagaramuḍi
cells.place: On a pillar set up in the graveyard (now removed to the bund of the tank)
cells.remarks: Perhaps a gift of land to the temple of Seturāmēsvara. Two of the faces are used for a modern epitaph. The other which is much damaged appears to be dated in Šaka 1[6]86, Chitrabhānu and mentions Gudipaṭi Subbarāju-Natāyanappa[m]garu.

cells.location: Tirubhuvanam
cells.place: On a stone built into the tank in front of the Tiruvēṅkaṭa-Perumāḷ temple
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Gift of sheep for a lamp [to the temple at Sērūr], a dēvudāna in Sērūr-kūgram by a native of Kiramāngalam which belonged to Poyyil-kūgram.

cells.location: Tiruneđungalam, Perambular taluk, Tiruchirappalli district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On another stone in the place of Tiruvēṅkaṭa-Perumāḷ. †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Contains a portion of the historical introduction of the king which begins with stirumayy.

cells.location: Tiruneđungalam, Perambular taluk, Tiruchirappalli district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the central shrine in Tiruvēṅkaṭa-Perumāḷ temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Sarasvatīsvāmin and to the shrine of Āḷvār, by a certain Govindadāsa for the merit of King Vijaya-Rāghava.

cells.place: On the wall of the maṇḍapa in front of Tiruvēṅkaṭa-Perumāḷ temple in the Sāra-Pārameśvara temple at Udaivārkōyil, a hamlet of the same village (as Tiruvēṅkaṭa-Perumāḷ temple). †
cells.remarks: Gift of money for a lamp to the temple of Tiruchochenneri-Udaiyar at Tiruchobhrai.

cells.location: Tiruneđungalam, Perambular taluk, Tiruchirappalli district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Sāra-Pārameśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of money for a lamp to the temple, at Tiruchobhrai alias Rajasundari-chaturvedi-mangalam, by a native of Kariveḍu in Damar-kōṭ-tam of Jayangonda-Chol[ma]ndalam.

cells.place: On the north wall of Sāra-Pārameśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Built in, at the bottom. Gift of land to the shrine of the goddess.

cells.place: On the wall of Sāra-Pārameśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Tiruchchōṛai-Uḍaiyār at Tiruchchōṛai by the assembly of Vāṇāpur.

cells.location: Tirubhuvanam
cells.place: On the wall of Sāra-Pārameśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged and built in, at the bottom. Gift of land by the same assembly.

cells.place: On the wall of Sāra-Pārameśvara †
cells.remarks: Sale of land to the temple of Tirunolhennari-Udaiyar at Rajasundarichaturvedimangalam, by the assembly of Vanavanmādēvi-chaturvēdimangalam, a brahmadeya in Seyyur-kurram which was a sub-division of Kulottunga-Chola-valanadu. Another inscription below this, is dated in the 9th year of Tribhuvanachakravartin Vikrama-Chōladēva and records sale of land.

cells.location: Tirubhuvanam
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the shrine of the goddess by a certain Ulaguyyavandan who purchased it from the assembly of Rajasundari-chaturvēdimangalam a brahmadeya in the same district.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of land for a lamp.

cells.location: Tiruneđungalam, Perambular taluk, Tiruchirappalli district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Contains a portion of the historical introduction of the king beginning with tirumanni.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land at Porigudi to two individuals who had to sing the Tiruppadiyam in the temple of Tirunallam. Damaged.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Begins with the historical introduction tiru maruviya sengōl, etc.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Records that the figure on the stone was one of Sūttan Gunahattan alias Haracharanaśekharan of Ālattan who caused this stone temple to be built [under orders of] Udaiya-Piratiiyar, mother of Madhurantakadėva alias Uttama-Chola. He was evidently raised to the dignity of Rajakēsari.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of a silver image (of the god?) and a copper image of Chandēśvara, by Kalkkō- Nakkan Nallattadigal, one of the members of the Rājarājatēriya-Kalkkōlar (community).

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Records the assembly of Tirunallam, a brahmadeya in Vegunadu, a subdivision of Uḍaiyār-pāḍi-valanadu and records a sale of land to the temple of Tirunallamudaiya-Mahādēva.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of money for a lamp.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of land for offerings to a shrine of Ganapati at Tirunallam which was a brahmadėya in Vennāđu.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged and unfinished. Seems to record a gift to the temple of Tirunallamudaiya-Mahadėya, by a queen.

cells.place: On the north, west and south walls of Umanabēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Built in, in the middle. Refer to the setting up of an image of Kṣētrapāla by the queen Arindavan-Mahādēvi.

cells.place: On the same walls
cells.remarks: Much damaged and built in, in the middle. Begins with the historical introduction whose first words are tirumalar pūmādu.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: On the same walls
cells.remarks: Built in, in the beginning. Records a gift of land and mentions that the assembly met in the temple of Madhurāntaki-Iśvaramuḍaiyār.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: On the same walls
cells.remarks: The beginning of the inscription is built in. Mentions Queen Sembiyan- Mahādēvi the mother of the king and refers to the temple at Tirunallam in the name of her husband Gandarāditya. At the end of this inscription is a record of the 8th year of Parakēsarivarman which refers to the king's palace in his camp at Panaiyūr near Karaikkadu.

cells.place: On the north wall of Umanabēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of paddy to a servant of the temple.

cells.location: Turaiyūr, Musiri taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of money for a lamp by a native of Tiruvāli in Tiruvaḷindāḍu, a sub-division of Vaḍagarai-Chōḷa-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of money for a lamp to the temple of Adityēśvaramuḍaiya-Mahādēva at Tirunallam.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refers to the 3rd year of the reign and to Ályar Parāntakan-Kundavai-I'iraṭṭiyar and her palace at Palaiyāru.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple at Tiruvāli by the assembly of Pavakkudi, a brāhmaṇadēya in Veṇṇāḍu, a sub-division of Uyyakkonḍār-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Tirumantirāṇṇamāḍa-Mahādēva [at Tiru-naḷḷam], by Aruḷiñjēri, a native of Vaḍagarai-Magalām in Veṇ-naḍu.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Records that some drummers of the temple agreed to beat drums and blow horns and conchs during the early morning service, in consideration of the money which they received from a private person.

cells.location: Ālambākkam, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Dc.
cells.remarks: Gift of gold ornaments and a silver bugle, by the wife of Vaṇakkoḍaiyar, a native of Karaikkāḍu, to the god Uḍaiyār Uḷuṇḍi-uḍaiyār.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: Dc.
cells.remarks: Gift of money for a lamp to the temple of Adityēśvaramuḍaiya-Mahādēva at Tirunallam.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: Dc.
cells.remarks: Gift of money for a lamp.

cells.place: On the south wall of the manḍapa in front of Umanabēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Built in, at both ends. Provides for the feeding of the Mahādēvas.

cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Refers to the assembly of Tirunallam, a brāhmaṇadēya in Veṇṇāḍu, a sub-division of Bhaṇḍāra-vaḷanāḍu and records a decision regarding the land belonging to the certain temple lands.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Built in at the end and the middle. Contains the historical introduction which commences with the words tirumaṇṇi-valara etc.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Built in, at the beginning. Gift of money for offerings by a native of Tiruvar in Iruṅgō-nāḍu, a sub-division of Vijayarājēndra-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land by the assembly of Pavaikkudi alias Nittavinoda-chaturvēdi-mangalam, for feeding the Mahēsvaras in the temple at Tirunalam. Another record in continuation which is incomplete at the right end, contains portions of the historical introduction of Vikrama-Chola and provides for the bathing and offerings for the god.

cells.location: Ālambākkam, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the manḍapa of Umanabēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for offerings.

cells.remarks: Mutilated. Seems to record a gift of land.

cells.location: Kōnērirājapuram
cells.place: On the wall of Umanabēśvara †
cells.remarks: Sale of land to the temple of Kailāsamuḍaiya-Mahādēva at Tirunallam by the assembly of Pavakkudi, alias Nitinirvinda-chaturvēdimangalam, a brāhmaṇadēya in Veṇṇāḍu which was a sub-division of Uyyakkonḍār-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the west wall of the manḍapa of Umanabēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Gift of jewels to the goddess.

cells.place: At the entrance into the Naṭarāja shrine in Umanabēśvara temple, right side. †
cells.king: Rājakesarivarman alias Uḍaiyār Śrī-Rājādhirājadēva who took the head of Vīra-Pāṇḍya, the Śalai of the Cheras and Laṅka.
cells.remarks: Gift of money for a lamp to the temple of Uṭṭamāḍa-Viṇṇagar Āḷvār at Tirumallam.

cells.place: In the place of Naṭarāja, left side †
cells.remarks: It is said to have 'taken the head of Pāṇḍya, the head of the Chēra, Laṅka (Ceylon) and Ratapāḍi' seven and a half lion and to have performed the anointment of victors at Kalyāṇapuram. Records the gift of a lamp to a Vaishṇava temple.

cells.place: On the gōpura of Naṭarāja shrine, right side of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Records the name of the donor of this gōpura (gōpuram), who was Muḍi-ippilla-Tirunāḷvār. Seems to record a gift of paddy for offerings.

cells.location: Ālambākkam, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west wall of the Chandikēśvara shrine in Naṭarāja shrine. †
cells.remarks: Representation of Chandēśvara worshipping the god. 'Tirunāḷvār' is cut on the stone wall.

cells.location: Ālambākkam, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east, north and west walls of Chandikēśvara shrine. †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to record a gift of paddy for the other shrine.

cells.location: Ālambākkam, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a pillar in the verandaḥ round the central shrine of Chandikēśvara shrine. †
cells.remarks: Records that the Tirunāḷvār-maṇḍapa was built by Aruḷmoḷidēvan alias Vaya-nāṭṭaraiyan of Aḍanūr. The same fact is recorded on another pillar of the verandaḥ.

cells.place: On the east wall of the first prākāra of Chandikēśvara shrine. †
cells.remarks: Appears to record a gift of land for garlands.

cells.location: Ālambākkam, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Chandikēśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to a shrine of Vinayaka-Piḷḷaiyār, set up on the south side of the Paḍikāval-maṇḍapa in the temple of Tirunāḷvār-Uḍaiyār.

cells.place: On a slab set up in a grove of trees near Māṇichambalam.
cells.remarks: Gift of the village of Uppur to the temple of Śrīraṅganātha, for conducting festivals and for planting a grove.

cells.location: Tiruneḍuṅgalam
cells.place: On the north, west and south walls of the central shrine in the temple of Neḍuṅgalanāthasvāmin,
cells.remarks: Refers to Nārāyaṇa-Nāyakar and to the founding of a village for the merit of Sōmaya-Vīravarāsa, 'lord of the Southern Ocean.'

cells.place: On the same walls.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land.

cells.place: On the north wall of the shrine of Neḍuṅgalanāthasvāmin. †
cells.remarks: Unfinished.

cells.place: On the north wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the shrine of Neḍuṅgalanāthasvāmin. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Tiruneḍuṅgala-Uḍaiya-Nāyanār in Vaḍagavi-nāḍu by a native of Kiliyūr in Kiliyūr-nāḍu, which was a sub-division of Pāṇḍyakulāśani-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Tiruneḍuṅgalam
cells.place: On the north wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the shrine of Neḍuṅgalanāthasvāmin. †

cells.place: On the wall of Neḍuṅgalanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the same temple (in Vaḍagavira nāḍu), by Tillai Tirunāṭṭap-perumāḷ alias Vijayālaya Muṭaraiyan of Vaḷambhakudi.

cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of land.

cells.place: On the south wall of the maṇḍapa of Neḍuṅgalanāthasvāmin. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of land to the temple of Neduṅgaḷattu Mahādēva, by a native of Kaḷḷikkuḍi in Eyi-nāḍu, a sub-division of Pāṇḍikulāśani vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the wall of Neḍuṅgalanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Gift of the village of Kaḍaiyakkuḍi (in Vaḍagaviranāḍu) surnamed Kamparājanallūr, by Kampayadēva Mahārāja, son of the Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Antambarakaṇḍaṉ Vallamarāja.

cells.location: Tiruneḍuṅgalam
cells.place: On the wall of Neḍuṅgalanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Gift of land.

cells.location: Tiruneḍuṅgalam
cells.place: On the wall of Neḍuṅgalanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Refers to a gift of land made in accordance with an earlier charter of Parakēsarivarman alias śrī-Vijayālaya-Chōḷadēva.

cells.location: Tiruneḍuṅgalam
cells.place: On the wall of Neḍuṅgalanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Gift of land and a house to the mason who repaired the temple.

cells.location: Tiruneḍuṅgalam
cells.place: On the wall of Neḍuṅgalanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction samasta jagad-ādhāra of Jaṭāvarman Sundara-Pāṇḍya. Gift of land by the people of Miśeṅgili-nāḍu in Teṅkarai Jayasiṅgakulakāla-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the east wall of the Chandikēśvara shrine in the temple of Neḍuṅgalanāthasvāmin. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Sale of land by certain members of the assembly of Tiruneduṅgaḷam alias Tyāgavallichaturvēdimaṅgalam, a brahmadēya in Vaḍagavira-nāḍu, a sub-division of Pāṇḍyakulāśani-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the north wall of Chandikēśvara shrine. †
cells.remarks: Records that a liṅga was set up in the first prākāra of the temple of Neduṅgaḷam-Uḍaiyār under the name Ulaganādīśvaram-Uḍaiyār, for the merit of Tillai Tirunaṭṭapperumāḷ alias Vijayālaya-Muttaraiyar of Vaḷambakuḍi, by one of his sons. Mentions Periyadēvar Tribhuvanavīradēva.

cells.place: On the west wall of Chandikēśvara shrine. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for a lamp by Arayaṉ Śivandakalaṅgiyaṉ of Puduvūr in Ārvala-kūṟṟam, a sub-division of Rājendra-Chōḷa-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the south wall of the Gaṇēśa shrine in Chandikēśvara shrine. †
cells.remarks: Gift of cows for pañchagavya to the temple of Mahādēva at Tiruneduṅgaḷam, a dēvadāna in Kavira-nāḍu. Provision was also made for lamps, for burning incense, etc.

cells.place: On the south wall of Gaṇēśa shrine †
cells.remarks: Records that an image called Lōkasundara was set up in the temple of Tiruneduṅgaḷattu-Āḻvār in Kavira-nāḍu, by a native of Oṟṟiyūr. Records also a gift of land for offerings.

cells.location: Śamayavaram, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Gift of land to a native of Śaralūr by the Mahēśvaras, the temple servants and the residents of the village of Neduṅgaḷam.

cells.location: Tiruneḍuṅgalam
cells.place: On the south wall of Gaṇēśa shrine †
cells.remarks: Gift of ghee for agnikārya in the same temple for the merit of Śembiyaṉ Mūvēndavēḷaṉ of Vaḍa Puṟaiyūr-nāḍu who appears to have had the title Uttamasōḻa-Brahmādhirājakaṉmi.

cells.location: Tiruneḍuṅgalam
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Gift of gold for a lamp to the shrine of Piḷḷaiyār-Gaṇapati, in the temple of Tiruneduṅgaḷam-Uḍaiyār by a certain Kōḷambanachchaṉ of Iḍaikkuḍi.

cells.location: Tiruneḍuṅgalam
cells.place: On the south wall of Gaṇēśa shrine †
cells.remarks: Gift of paddy for offerings.

cells.location: Mudigondam, Kollegal taluk, Coimbatore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west wall of Gaṇēśa shrine. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for feeding the Sivayogins, by a native of Orriyur which was a devadāna and brahmādāya in Vilā-nāḍu.

cells.place: On the wall of Gaṇēśa †
cells.remarks: Gift of land by the assembly of Tirumuṇḍaiyūram, to a private person who had to provide paddy to the temple for offerings, 'commencing from the year opposite to the year opposite to' the date of grant.

cells.location: Mudigondam, Kollegal taluk, Coimbatore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of Gaṇēśa shrine. †
cells.remarks: Gift of sheep for a lamp.

cells.location: Mudigondam, Kollegal taluk, Coimbatore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Gaṇēśa †
cells.remarks: Gift of land by a private individual, for the supply of paddy for offerings in the temple of Kayilāyatta-Mahādēva.

cells.location: Tiruneḍuṅgalam
cells.place: On the wall of Gaṇēśa †
cells.remarks: Mentions the destruction of the ships at Salai and the king's conquest of Gaṅgaipāḍi, Nuḷambapāḍi, Nuḷambapāḍi and Taḍigaivāḷi. Records also that Kamban Māṇiyan alias Vikramaśiṅgamūvēndavēḷān made a gift of a gold ornament (?) and a copper-tipped marakkāl for a ritual service in the temple.

cells.place: On the south wall of the Sōmaśkanda shrine in Gaṇēśa shrine. †
cells.remarks: Records that Araṉ Aḷavai Vallabhadeva of Maḷukkuḍi built the Raṅga-maṇḍapa of the temple and made a gift of land and a house for offerings, to the shrine of (?) Kaḷaṇḍi-Nāyakar.

cells.place: On the west wall of Sōmaśkanda shrine. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for repairs, offerings and festivals, to the temple of Tirunedungalamudaiya Tambiránár [also called | Nilalaršolaivanamudaiya-Nayanár, by a sámanta.] Refers to an earlier grant by the sámanta Tirumalairája.

cells.place: On the gōpura of Sōmaśkanda shrine, right of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Refers to a king who received tribute from all countries and from Ceylon and witnessed the elephant hunt.

cells.place: In the place of Sōmaśkanda †
cells.remarks: Gift of money for offerings by Periya-tđirila sámantanár, son of Virappa-Náyakka Sámantanár alias Alagappa Sámantanár, for the merit of his mother.

cells.place: On a fragment built into the wall of a maṇḍapa in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Gift of money for a lamp to the temple of Malaiyāra and refers to Mēśaliṅgāḍa and the Pandya king Varaguṇa-Mahārāja. Another fragment built into the same wall refers itself to the reign of [Madi]rai-koṇḍa [Para]kēsarivarman.

cells.place: On a slab set up in a street of the same village (as Sōmaśkanda shrine). †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for worship in the temple of Tirunedungalanáthasvámi.

cells.location: Teraiyūr
cells.place: On a fragment built into the wall of a maṇḍapa in Sōmaśkanda shrine. †
cells.remarks: Refer to an order of Akalaṅkanāyakaṉ and records a grant of land to the temple of Uḷaguyyavanda-Chōḷēśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyanār, built by Śembiyan-yāṇḍār of the [Ba]lī Tuṇiyūr.

cells.place: On the wall of Vālīśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the same temple, built by Sembiyan Virátaráyan of Veljór at Turaiyúr in Rajarajavalanádu.

cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Chōḷēśvara temple in the same village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of land to the temple of Tiru[ch]chīrra-jambala-uḍaiya-Nāyanār built at Iḷaiyūr by Gorudumaiya of that village.

cells.place: On the south wall of Chōḷēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the shrines of Nallanātha and Subrahmanya-Piḷḷaiyār in the temple of Vallava-nāḍu-uḍaiya-Nāyanār at Iṟaiyūr (on the bank of the river) Kiḷ-Pāḷaru, in Pāchoḷ-kūṟṟam, a sub-division of Rājarāja-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Chōḷēśvara temple in the same village (as Vālīśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the same temple. Tiraiyūru (was situated on the bank) of Kiḷ Pāḷaru, in Pāchoḷ-kūṟṟam, a sub-division of Rājarāja-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On a slab set up in the Varadarāja-Perumāḷ temple in the same village (as Chōḷēśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Records gifts of land to the temple of Kōdaṇḍarāma-perumāḷ.

cells.location: Aḷambākkam
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Saḷḷiyamman temple
cells.remarks: Built in at the beginning. Records that the temple of Pidāri was [built?] by a certain Irāyar Aḷambākkamuḍaiyār [Tiru-Uṛaiyūru] and seems to register a gift of land for offerings.

cells.place: On the wall of Saḷḷiyamman †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of land to the temple of Saptamātṛis by the assembly of Daṇṭivarumaṅgalam.

cells.place: On the west and south walls of Saḷḷiyamman temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refers to the assembly of Madhurantakachaturvédimañgalam a brahmadéya in Poygai-nadú, a sub-division of Rajéndrašinga-valanađú and records a gift of land to the temple of Saptamátrikas.

cells.place: On the north wall of the Aiyaṇār temple in the same village (as Saḷḷiyamman temple). †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Mentions Gandaráditya-Chaturvédimañgalam, a brahmadéya on the northern bank (of the Cauvery), and its hemlet Si[ru]maruvúr.

cells.place: On the wall of Aiyaṇār †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Gift of lamp to a temple of Śrī-Kṛishṇa-perumāḷ at Tiruvāy-pāḍi, by a resident of Daṇṭivarumaṅgalam which was a brāhmadēya on the northern bank (of the Cauvery).

cells.place: On the north wall of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Mentions the image of Śrī-Vāsudēva and provides for offerings and lamps.

cells.place: On the south wall of the central shrine in the Varadarāja-Perumāḷ temple in the same village.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Registers a gift of sheep for a lamp for the merit of an individual who died of an accident. Mentions Sittirāḍi and Tiruvāypāḍi.

cells.place: On the wall of Varadarāja-Perumāḷ †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for a lamp below the tank called Mārpīḍugēri at Daṇṭivarma-maṅgalam, to the temple of Tirumāl-Perumāḷ by a member of the gōpa who managed the affairs of the village.

cells.location: Aḷambākkam
cells.place: On the wall of Varadarāja-Perumāḷ †
cells.remarks: Gift of land below the tank of Mārpīḍugēri and records that a certain temple of Vappa-ḍaṇḍa-gōpa the temple of Tiruvāḷūr-Perumāḷ-aḍigaḷ at Daṇṭivarumaṅgalam, by a private individual who purchased it from the assembly (sabhā) of the village.

cells.location: Aḷambākkam
cells.place: On the wall of Varadarāja-Perumāḷ †
cells.remarks: Mentions Madhurantakapporéri and records that a certain Viṭappa-Dandanáyaka, son of a general of Nárasin[ha]déva and a native of a village near Madhurantakam in Tondaji-mandalam, renewed the Tirumérkóyil which had 'a long time back' been founded to the west of the Kayiláyamuđaiyar temple and had since become dilapidated.

cells.location: Irumbudalai, Papanasam taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of Varadarāja-Perumāḷ temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Gift of land below the tank of Mārpīḍugēri, to the temple of Tirumāl-Perumāḷ-aḍigaḷ at Daṇṭivarumaṅgalam, a brāhmadēya on the northern bank (of the Cauvery).

cells.place: On the south wall of the central shrine in the Kailāsanātha temple in the same village (as Varadarāja-Perumāḷ temple). †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Amardēvara-Perumāḷ. Mentions Daṇṭivarumaṅgalam and Mārpīḍugēri.

cells.place: On the wall of Kailāsanātha †
cells.remarks: Damaged and built in, at the end. Mentions the assembly of the village of [Madhu]rāntaka-chaturvēdimaṅgalam [a brāhmadēya] in Po[ṇṇai-nāḍu], a sub-division of Rājēndrasiṅga-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the north wall of Kailāsanātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged and built in, at the end. Contains an unfinished historical introduction of Rājādhirāja which begins Tingaḷēr taru.

cells.place: On the wall of Kailāsanātha †
cells.remarks: Records that the assembly of Madhurāntaka-chaturvēdimangalam met in the temple of Tiruvīraṭṭāṇam-Uḍaiyār of this village, and made a gift of land to the temple of Tiruvīraṭṭāṇam-Uḍaiyār-Mahādēva.

cells.location: Aḷambākkam
cells.place: On the wall of Kailāsanātha †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Kailāsamuḍaiya-Mahādēva of Madhurāntaka-chaturvēdimangalam, by the assembly of that village.

cells.location: Aḷambākkam
cells.place: On the wall of Kailāsanātha †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Amarēsāvara-Perumaļ at Dantivarmamaņgalam, by the assembly (sabhā) of that village.

cells.location: Aḷambākkam
cells.place: On the wall of Kailāsanātha †
cells.remarks: Records that some servants of the temple residing in Madhurāntaka-chaturvēdimangalam received 5 kāśu from a merchant of that village and agreed to supply paddy towards interest, in order to maintain a lamp in the temple of Kailāsamuḍaiya-Mahādēva.

cells.location: Aḷambākkam
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Built in, in the middle. Contains a portion of the historical introduction of Rajadhiraja I, which begins tiṅgalēr taru.

cells.place: On the south wall of the maṇḍapa in front of Kailāsanātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Records that a lady built a maṇḍapa in Kailāsa i.e., the temple of Kailāsanātha which was founded by Danti.

cells.place: On the north wall of Kailāsanātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Records that a native of Alambakkam in Poygaināḍu, a sub-division of Ulaguḍai-Muḷukkōḍi-āṇḍanāḍu, agreed to give a specified quantity of paddy to the assembly of Madhurāntaka-chaturvēdimangalam. Mentions Tribhuvanachakravartin Kōnērinmaikoṇḍān.

cells.place: On the east wall of Kailāsanātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land in Poygaināḍu, a sub-division of Tribhuvanamādēvi-vaḷanāḍu, to the shrine of Aluḍaiya-Piḷḷaiyār. The assembly had met in Madhurāntakadēva maṇḍapa of this village, at the time when the gift was made.

cells.place: On the wall of Kailāsanātha †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for offerings and for the sacred bath of the image in the temple of Kailāsamuḍaiya-Mahādēva at Madhurāntaka-chaturvēdimangalam, a brahmādya in Poygaināḍu, a sub-division of Vaḍagarai-Tyāgavalli-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On a pillar of Kailāsanātha temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of the maṇḍapa by a certain Uyyavanda of Kōḍaikkaḍi by the grace of Danti.

cells.place: On the gōpura of Kailāsanātha temple, right of entrance. †
cells.remarks: Gift of a house.

cells.place: In the place of Kailāsanātha †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Kailāsamuḍaiya-Mahādēva, by the Veḷḷāḷar of Madhurāntaka-chaturvēdimangalam and its hamlets.

cells.place: On the same gōpura, left of entrance.
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the same temple by a native of Vaṅgipuram.

cells.place: In the same place
cells.king: Tribhuvanachakravartin Rājādhirāja-dēva, (who was pleased to take [I]lam (Ceylon) and)
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records that the Śivabrāhmaṇa of Madhurāntaka-chaturvēdimangalam borrowed some money from the temple treasury and agreed to burn a lamp in the temple of Kailāsamuḍaiya-dēva, for the interest on the amount borrowed.

cells.location: Aḷambākkam
cells.place: In the place of Kailāsanātha †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to record a gift of land and mentions Madhurāntakap-pērēri.

cells.place: In the place of Kailāsanātha †
cells.remarks: Sale of land and a house, to the temple.

cells.location: Puṇṭaikōil
cells.place: On the south wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Muktīśvara temple
cells.remarks: Gift of a village to the temple of Tirumuttīśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyaṇār at Kaḍuvankuḍi by the inhabitants of Muḍiyakkūḍi-nāḍu and Vaḍa Kōṇāḍu which were sub-divisions of Uṛattūr-kurram in Kōṇāḍu alias Kaḍalaiyaḍai-yāḷaṅgoṇḍa Chōḷavaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the wall of Muktīśvara †
cells.remarks: Mentions that the residence of Kaḍuvankuḍi was an endowment of a dancing girl to the temple of Muttīśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyaṇār.

cells.location: Puṇṭaikōil
cells.place: On the wall of Muktīśvara †
cells.language: Tamil (verse and prose). †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Mentions Kaḍuvankuḍi and [Koḍu]n-ba-ḷanāyaka Vēḷar of Koḍumbāḷūr.

cells.location: Puṇṭaikōil
cells.place: On the wall of Muktīśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of the village of Aḷugiya-Śēmanallūr to the temple of Tirumuttīśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyaṇār at Kaḍuvankuḍi, a sub-division of Uṛattūr-kurram, which was a district of Kaḍalaiyaḍai-yāḷaṅgoṇḍa-Chōḷa-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Puṇṭaikōil
cells.place: On the wall of Muktīśvara †
cells.remarks: Endowment of a dancing girl to the temple of Muttīśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyaṇār.

cells.location: Puṇṭaikōil — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Muktīśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Kaḍalakkūḍi and seems to record a gift of land to the same temple.

cells.place: On the west wall of Muktīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land by the residents of [Kaḍuvankuḍi] to the temple of Muttīśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyaṇār at [Pa]juḷūr-in Kaḍuvankuḍi-parru, in Muḍiyakkūḍi-nāḍu in Uṛattūr-kurram, in Kōṇāḍu alias Kaḍalaiyaḍai-yāḷaṅgoṇḍa-Chōḷa-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the north wall of Muktīśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the same temple.

cells.place: On the wall of Muktīśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land by the residents of Maḷu-Kaḍuvankuḍi, Kiḷai-Kaḍuvankuḍi and Poygai.

cells.location: Puṇṭaikōil
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Mentions Kaduvankudi-parru alias Pārattūr.

cells.location: Kiḷakkudi, Madura taluk, Madura district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of Muktīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Seems to record an agreement among the temple servants.

cells.location: Puṇṭaikōil — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of Muktīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of money for offerings and festivals.

cells.place: On the south wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Muktīśvara temple near Śaṇḍya-varam.
cells.remarks: Gift of land for offerings to the temple of Kaḷugai-Nāyaṇār at Māgaṇikuḍi, [a village on the bank of] Kiḷ-Paḷaru, in Pāṇḍikūḷi-kurram, a sub-division of Vaḍagarai Rājārāja-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the west wall of the kitchen in Muktīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Much damaged and stones missing.

cells.place: On the west wall of the kitchen in Muktīśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record that a Nāyaka built one of the walls of the kitchen.

cells.location: Siddhavattam
cells.place: On a slab set up on the tank-bund
cells.remarks: Mutillated. Mentions Kollagaru and records a gift of 6 gadyāṇas for a lamp, granted by the temple of Āditya.

cells.location: Mudi-gondam
cells.place: On the south wall of the Lakshmī-Nārāyaṇasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Mentions a long list of bīrudas of the king.

cells.location: Alagarmalai, Melur taluk, Madurai district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Lakshmī-Nārāyaṇasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Mentions Muđigondashōlapuram alias Dēśi-Uyyakkondapatāṇa and records that the merchants of the 18 towns (north of the Kavēri river) including Talajkkādu alias Rajurajapura and those of the 15 towns south of the same river including Muđigondachōlapuram made grants to the temple of Nāra-yaca-Perumāl also called 'Dēśi-Perumāl'

cells.location: Mudi-gondam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Lakshmī-Nārāyaṇasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Gift of land for festivals in the same temple.

cells.location: Mudi-gondam
cells.place: On the wall of Lakshmī-Nārāyaṇasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Provides for offerings in the temple of Dēśi-Perumāl at Muđigondashōlapuram alias Dēśi-Uyyakkondashōlapatāṇam in Padi-nādu, a sub-division of Gangaikondashōla-valanadu of Muđigondashōla-maṇplalam.

cells.place: On the west wall of Lakshmī-Nārāyaṇasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Mentions Kollagar and records a gift of land to the same temple.

cells.place: On the north wall of Lakshmī-Nārāyaṇasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of an areca garden to the same temple by the mahđījanas of Durgaijāragaram.

cells.place: On the west wall of the Muḍigoṇḍa-vara temple in the same village (as Lakshmī-Nārāyaṇasvāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: Gift of money for a lamp to the temple of Muđigondachōlaisvaram-Udniyar. On the other walls of this temple are fragments of Tamil inscriptions which are not connected with one another and do not form a complete record. Some of the fragments refer to the Chōla king Vikrama-Chōla, others to the merchants of Muđigondachōlapuram and the rest to gifts of lamps.

cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Mallachamma temple in the same village (as Muḍigoṇḍa-vara temple). †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Mollachchi by Dasaya-Nāyaka son of Agattiyāndi-Nāyakkar who was the Commander (sēṇapati) of the relangui force of the king. Mentions Alakkamindaṇ.

cells.place: On a slab built into the steps on the southern side of the tank in the same village (as Mallachamma temple). †
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Gift of a village in Naḍi-nāḍu to the temple of Nakkara-jinālaya at Muḍigoṇḍa-śōḷapuram dedicated to [Chan]drabhānavāmi, for repairs and worship.

cells.place: On a slab built into the steps on the west side of the same tank.
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Mentions Muḍigoṇḍa-śōḷapura alias Dēśi-Uyyakkoṇḍaśōḷapaṭ-ṭaṇa.

cells.place: On a slab built into the floor of the Śiva temple in the same village (as Mallachamma temple). †
cells.remarks: Mutilated incomplete and damaged. Contains a list of the king's con-quests.

cells.location: Koḷḷē-gal
cells.place: On the south wall of the Lakshmī-nārāyaṇasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Mentions Koṅguṇi-tank (tank) and records a gift of land to the temple of Viṭṭuruda-Perumāḷ at Koḷḷēgal alias Tribhuvanamādēvi-chaturvēdiman-galam. Refers also to the temple of Muḍigoṇḍa-Uḍaiyār at Muḍi-goṇḍaśōḷapuram.

cells.place: On the west wall of Lakshmī-nārāyaṇasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of money for a lamp to the same temple. The village is called Koḷḷēgal alias Tribhuvanamādēvi-chaturvēdimangalam.

cells.location: Tiruvāṇaikkāval (Jambukēśvaram), Perambular taluk, Tiruchirappalli district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the entrance into Lakshmī-nārāyaṇasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of the village of Koḷḷēgāla which belongs to Śivanasamudra-sthala in Haḍināḍu-sime, to a certain Rāmarāja-Nāyaka, by Rāmarājadēva-Mahā-arasu, son of the Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Rāmarāja-Tirumalarājayya.

cells.place: On a slab built into the steps in the place of Lakshmī-nārāyaṇasvāmin. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Vaṇḍuvāsi-Perumāḷ. The village is called Koḷḷēgal alias Tribhuvanamādēvi-chaturvēdimangalam, as in No. 14.

cells.place: On a third slab lying in the place of Lakshmī-nārāyaṇasvāmin. †
cells.remarks: Refers to the merchants of Ayyapolil and records a gift to the temple of Manalēśvaramuḍaiya-Mahādēva, by the residents of Koḷḷagāḷas Tribhuva-nāmādēvi-chaturvvēdimangalam in Paṭi-nāḍu.

cells.location: Siṅganallūr
cells.place: On a slab set up in the courtyard of the Basavēśvara temple
cells.remarks: Refers to the 500 merchants of Ayyāvaḷe and records a gift by these, at Siṅganallūru for feeding the members of their community.

cells.place: On another slab set up in the same, Basavēśvara temple. †
cells.date: Kali 4522 (wrong) and Šaka 1830, Sarvadhári. Saka 1581, Vikari.
cells.remarks: Some of the birudas of the king are new. Mentions the mahāpradhāna Nāganāyaka-Oḍeya.

cells.place: On a slab lying outside Basavēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions a certain Dēvarāja Voḍeya and Śiṅganallūru.

cells.location: Kuṇḍūru
cells.place: On a slab set up to the east of the Basavēśvara temple
cells.remarks: Hadināḍu-sime was under the rule of the mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Nandyāla Nar-iṅga-yarāyaṇ. Records a gift to the mahāmaṇḍala-maṭha at Kuṇḍūru.

cells.place: On another slab in the place of Basavēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Refers to the king's đhujabala-pradhána Rámábhatáyya.

cells.place: On the third slab set up in the place of Basavēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Gift of taxes in the village of Kuntúr in Hadi-nádu for providing food and clothing to fifty vođeyars of the Sivachára sect, who were connected with the Salúra Santadévara-Sim hasana.

cells.place: On two slabs lying in front of the Mahaliṅgēśvara temple in the same village (as Basavēśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to a temple of Mahādēva at Kuṇḍūru, by Parabbēyarāśi who was ruling Kuṇḍūru.

cells.place: On the north wall of Unnatapurēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Tiruvagaṭṭīśvaramuḍaiya-Mahādēva at Peṛ-Miḷāṭūr, by a native of that village.

cells.place: On the south wall of the Vighnēśvara shrine in the courtyard of Unnatapurēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of sheep (for a lamp).

cells.location: Tirumūḍalai

cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of sheep (for a lamp).

cells.place: On the north and west tiers of the same base.

cells.remarks: Records that Māṇikkam, a disciple of Kurandi-Aṭṭanpavadai, caused this image to be cut in the name of the inhabitants of the district.

cells.place: On the same boulder ..
cells.remarks: Damaged in the beginning. Records that Abinandan-Bhaṭāra (1), [pupil of] Arimandala-Bhaṭāra, pupil of Abinandan-Bhaṭāra (2), [pupil of] Kana-kamuṇḍi-Bhaṭāra of Kurandi-Tirukkuṭṭakkalbali, caused this image to be cut.

cells.place: On the same boulder, below a Jaina figure,
cells.remarks: Records that Guṇamaṇiyar mother of Ajjēnaṇi, caused this image to be cut.

cells.place: In the place of Karkaṭēśvara †
cells.remarks: Records that the image was caused to be cut on behalf of a certain Aṇochan-kaḍaippuram, a pupil of Guṇasandēva who was in charge of this paḷḷi/ Sripiṇyan nephew of Aṉattaiyāṉ Māgēṇaṇ a disciple of Guṇasandēva who was in charge of this paḷḷi.

cells.place: Below the Jaina figure, out on the boulder inside the Seṭṭippōdam near the tank, in the Uṇṇamā[lai] hill near Kiḷakkōḍi.
cells.remarks: Records that the image was caused to be cut, by Kanday Forpatting of Siru-kaḍaippuram, a pupil of Guṇasandēva who was in charge of this paḷḷi/ Records that the image was caused to be cut on behalf of Veḻan Seḍaiyaṉ, a shepherd of Pāruūr in Miḷalai-kūṟṟam, by his wife.

cells.place: At a spot called Peśchi-pallam on the hill of Karkaṭēśvara; below a Jaina figure. †
cells.remarks: Records that the image was caused to be cut by Kaṇaka[nā]ṭi, a servant of Tiruku[ra]l of Veṇbā-nāḍu.

cells.place: In the place of Karkaṭēśvara †
cells.remarks: Records that the image was caused to be made on behalf of his younger brother by Araiyangāvaḍi pupil of Guṇasandēva who was in charge of this paḷḷi.

cells.remarks: Gift of land to the shrine of the goddess by certain residents of Śiruvēlūr in Paṇaiyūr-nāḍu, a sub-division of Kaḷattūr-Chōḷa-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the east wall of the same prākāra.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Provides for a lamp.

cells.place: On the north wall of the prākāra of Māgālēśvaram. †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Gift of money for a lamp by a native of Kuṇḍavai-chaturvēdimangalam in Mīy-pūḻi-nāḍu, a sub-division of Gēyamāṇikka-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the wall of Māgālēśvaram †
cells.remarks: Seems to record a gift of land for offerings, to the temple of Ambar-Tirunāgalam-Udaiyar in Ambar-nāđu, a sub-division of Bhūpālakulava[1]li-valanāđu, by certain residents of Siruveļor.

cells.location: Tiruvāṇaikkā
cells.place: On the wall of Māgālēśvaram †
cells.remarks: Gift of paddy for offerings, to the image of Ārkoṇḍa-Nāyaṉar.

cells.place: On the east wall of the same prākāra.
cells.remarks: Gift of land for a lamp by Iḷavaṅgaṉḍan alias Rājārāja Paṇaiyūr-nāṭṭu Māvaṇḍavāḻāṉ, a native of Śiruvēlūr and others.

cells.place: On the wall of Māgālēśvaram †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gift of money for two lamps.

cells.location: Tiruvāṇaikkā
cells.place: On the wall of Māgālēśvaram †
cells.remarks: Records that a land of the temple of Mudungavūr which was being enjoyed by a private individual by mistake was given back to the temple at the instance of Vaṇḍuvāḻiṉ and Nuḷambadhirājaṉ.

cells.location: Tiruvāṇaikkā
cells.place: On the wall of Māgālēśvaram †
cells.remarks: Registers the release of the land referred to in No. 111 and mentions the 4th year of Rāja[rājadēva].

cells.place: On a slab lying in the courtyard of Māgālēśvaram temple. †
cells.remarks: Gift of 50 lamps to the temple of Mahākāḷattu-Mahādēva at Ambar, by a native of Aṅga-Vaḷḷavappāḍi.

cells.place: On another slab lying in the place of Māgālēśvaram. †
cells.remarks: Gift of a crown set with gems to the temple of Mahākāḷattu-Mahādēva by Karipuḷiyaṉ alias Sōḷāntakaṉ of Paḷavūr in Kuṟu-kūṟṟam.

cells.place: On the third stone in the same place.
cells.remarks: Gift of 90 sheep for a lamp by Udayamārttaṇḍaṉ, son of Māmmaṇḍaṉ who was a native of Śiruvēlūr in Paṇaiyūr-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.place: On the third stone in the place of Māgālēśvaram. †
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Gift of land to the temple of Tirumāgalattu Mahadėva at Ambar-nāđu, by a certain Vanarāyan Arāṅgan Mādėvan.

cells.place: On the same stone
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Mentions Kaṇi Puḷiyaṉ alias Sōḷavāyar of Paḷavūr in Kuṟu-kūṟṟam and the servants of the temple of Ambar-ari-Mahākāḷam.

cells.location: Śolavandān
cells.place: On a slab set up on the platform of the Railway Station
cells.remarks: Gift of 25 cow for a lamp, to the big temple' at .. which was a brahmadėva is Paganūr-kōram, by the wife of Tennavan Agukkappārarai-yan alias Pupaiyan Māpikkaṇ who was a native of Perum-Pāgaṇur.

cells.location: Rājasiṅgamaṅgalam
cells.place: On the north, west and south walls of the central shrine in the Kailāsanāthasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Stones out of order. Mentions Rājasiṅgamaṅgalam, a brahmadēya in Vāra-guṇa-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: Vombāṅguḍi
cells.place: On a stone set up in the bed of the tank
cells.remarks: Records a gift for the merit of Tirumalai-Nāyakkarayyan.

cells.location: Tenkarai
cells.place: On the south wall of the first prākāra of the Mūlasthānēśvara temple
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the ascetics in the Vananāyakap-maṭha situated south of the temple of Mulasthānam-Udaiyar in Ten-Kallaga-nādū, by certain residents of Solakulantaka-chaturvēdimaṅgalam, in Pāganūr-kōṇram.

cells.place: On the wall of Mūlasthānēśvara †
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land to the same maṭha.

cells.place: On the west wall of the prākāra of Mūlasthānēśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Mentions Teṉ-Kaḷḷaga-nāḍu.

cells.place: On the wall of Mūlasthānēśvara †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Quotes the 10th year of Sundara-Pāṇḍyadēva and mentions the Aḷaiyāṇḍāṉ-tiru-maṇḍapam in the same temple.

cells.location: Tenkarai
cells.place: On the wall of Mūlasthānēśvara †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Mentions Teṉ-Kaḷḷaga-nāḍu.

cells.location: Tenkarai
cells.place: On the wall of Mūlasthānēśvara †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Mentions the Tirujñāṉasambandar-tiru-maṇḍapam in the same temple.

cells.place: On the north wall of the prākāra of Mūlasthānēśvara †
cells.remarks: Mentions a resident of Tirupputtār, the twelfth hamlet of Solakulantaka-chaturvēdimaṅgalam which was a brahmadēya in l'aganūr-kōṇram; also refers to the temple of Mulasthānam-Udaiyar at Kaṭṭikkalār in Ten-Kallaga-nādū, a sub-division of Madurodaya-valanādū. Contains only the historical introduction.

cells.place: On the wall of Mūlasthānēśvara †
cells.remarks: Mentions a resident of Tirupputtār, the twelfth hamlet of Solakulantaka-chaturvēdimaṅgalam which was a brahmadēya in l'aganūr-kōṇram; also refers to the temple of Mulasthānam-Udaiyar at Kaṭṭikkalār in Ten-Kallaga-nādū, a sub-division of Madurodaya-valanādū. Contains only the historical introduction.

cells.location: Tenkarai
cells.place: On the wall of Mūlasthānēśvara †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Records the building of the shrine of the goddess and a gift to the other orders of Nīrattāṅguḍi-uḍaiyār.

cells.location: Tenkarai
cells.place: On the wall of Mūlasthānēśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of the village of Sengulam alīsa [V]iraivaviṭankanallūr, to the temple of Mulasthānamndaiya-Mahādēva in Kaṭṭikkalār at the request of Seramān Tōlan.

cells.place: On a pillar of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in Mūlasthānēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Records a gift of land for offerings to the temple of Śrivallava-Vinnagar-Ālār at the western bank (of the Vaigai river), at Solakulantaka-chaturvēdimaṅgalam in Pāganūr-kōṇram. The remainder of the record is stated to have been continued on a pillar (to the west of this). This pillar, however, does not now exist.

cells.place: On another pillar in Mūlasthānēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Records that a certain Kōḍuṅga-Chōḷa made a gift of land to the temple of Madhubid (i.e. Vishnu) in the village of Teṉur alias Jananātha-chaturvēdimuṅgalam.

cells.place: On the third pillar in the place of Mūlasthānēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the temple of Śrīvallava-Viṇṇagar-Āḷvār, at the request of Māḷavarāyar.

cells.place: On the fourth pillar in the place of Mūlasthānēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Damagad. Gift of land situated at Perundēgūr by Jananātha-Pallavaraiyan alias Kōdādān-Solai, to the god Sri-Vitakērala-Vinnagardēvar of Nadūvil-Śtikōyil at Jananātha-chaturvēdimaṅgalam in Pāganūr-kūrram.

cells.place: On the fifth pillar in the place of Mūlasthānēśvara †
cells.remarks: Gift of land by the assembly of Śūḻikōṭṭai-kūṟṟam, to the servants of the vēgudhaṇa of Kuṟuvār-dēvar situated in the north hamlet of the village.

cells.place: On the sixth and seventh pillars in the place of Mūlasthānēśvara. †
cells.remarks: Records that the pillars were the gift of a certain Kaṇḍan, Uḍaiyān of Valla-magara, a village in Maḷaimaṇḍalam.

cells.place: On a slab lying in Mūlasthānēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Mutilated.

cells.place: On a stone set up in the courtyard of Mūlasthānēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Mentions [the merchants of?] Ayyapoḷil.

cells.place: On a pillar in the gōpura of Mūlasthānēśvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Contains portions of the historical introduction of the king.

cells.remarks: Mutilated. In modern characters. Mentions the street called after [Rāya]ṇārāyaṇan and a tank.
